statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Forever's design cut dungeon kill XP sharply and raised dungeon quest XP a lot. The aim was a weak repeat run and a rewarding first run (developer Kris Zierhut, interview).

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Beta, 1 Oct: dungeon quests give 50% less of their **extra** XP above normal quest values. They still pay more than ordinary quests.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Beta, 8 Oct: kill XP in dungeons up about 20%.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Beta, 8 Oct: party kill XP was previously penalised based on the highest-level member. It reverted to Classic Era behaviour, where only each individual's level matters. The developer note adds that a member far above the enemy still means no one gets XP, as intended.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Beta, 8 Oct: several dungeon quest rewards were lowered from Rare to Uncommon.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Live, 8 Nov around 11:05 PST: kill XP in dungeons increased by 50%, so that repeat runs feel more rewarding. The post doesn't mention quest XP. The consolidated hotfix list files this under 9 Nov.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Live, 13 Nov: killing a dungeon enemy gives zero XP to all party members if the enemy is "trivial" to one or more members. No number was given.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Live, 14 Nov (posted 15 Nov): Blizzard said the 13 Nov rule "missed the mark". The party now gets no XP from enemies only when its highest member is **over 12 levels above** them. Instances already running kept the old rule. **This rule is current.**

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: The Nov 13 hotfix notes describe the original dungeon XP restriction. Blizzard announced the replacement threshold of more than 12 levels in a separate post.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: 10 Nov: most quests of level 48 and above now also award gold.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: 17 Nov: "Agamaggan's Blood" is no longer a dungeon quest. 16 Nov: the repeatable "Water Pouch Bounty" no longer gives XP. 10 Nov: Shatterspear trolls no longer give XP.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Classic gray-level formula: no mobs are gray at levels 1–5. At 6–39 a mob is gray at L − floor(L/10) − 5. At 40–59 it is gray at L − floor(L/5) − 1. At 60, mobs of level 51 and below are gray. So a gray gap is 5–12 levels, never more than 12. Forever is not confirmed to use this formula.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Group XP split in Classic: in a 5-player group, each member gets solo XP ÷ 5 × 1.4.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: "Kill XP is now 60% of Classic Era" (said to come from Kaivax on 10 Nov): no matching staff post exists in the cited thread. **Unverified.**

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Player-measured XP: the VanCleef turn-in pays 9,750 before 1 Oct and 6,175 after (Classic: 2,600). Three Deadmines quests pay 12,825 combined (Classic: 5,400). Kill XP is estimated at about 45% of Classic after 8 Nov.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Players get a lot from the first full-quest run. Repeat XP is worse than questing.

statements.title: Forever dungeon XP rules
statements.text: Quest XP is not split in a group. Every member who completes a quest gets the full amount. This is standard WoW behaviour.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Group Finder is a Classic-style listing board. It doesn't match players automatically and doesn't teleport. You walk to the entrance. Meeting stones don't summon. The only summon is the warlock's Ritual of Summoning.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Group Finder postings support an in-game voice mode (8 Oct). The LFG list updates eligibility, and the "Show All Level Ranges" checkbox works (16 Oct). So by default the dungeon list is filtered to what you're eligible for.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: You can group, run dungeons and raid only with characters on the same ruleset and faction.
The November 20 hotfix halved the hourly reset and re-entry allowance for each dungeon, from ten to five.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Raids reset weekly. Repeated dungeon resets and entries have a separate hourly limit of five per dungeon.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Many dungeon quest items, such as the Deadwood Key, now drop for every party member who has the quest (9 and 13 Nov). Riverglades quest drops are shared with the party (6 Nov).

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Some item-started dungeon quests can't be shared (for example A Crumpled Up Note and Head of Balnazzar). Each player has to loot their own.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Waylaid Crates and Craftsman's Writs can drop inside dungeons (9 Nov).

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Pix Xizzix's weekly dungeon quests are removed from the quest log at weekly reset (13 Nov). One version asks for three Dire Maul items and rewards an Undermine Satchel.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: World buffs are removed inside dungeons and raids. Tarnished Undermine Reals drop from bosses in dungeons of level 55 and up.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Most dungeons can be entered with up to 10 players; Blackrock Depths is limited to 5.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Dungeon drops unlock transmog for eligible looters. Tarnished Undermine Real currency drops in dungeons.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Riverglades is a new zone for levels 35–45 with 150+ quests. Other new zones: Mount Hyjal, Shen'dralas (between Mulgore and Desolace) and Zephras Isle (Skyborne starting zone, levels 1–12).

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Riverglades travel: Farholde Keep (Alliance) and Rog'mar (Horde) flight paths, plus a neutral boat from Powderfuse Port to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. Alliance can walk in from Redridge.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Forever adds a boat stop at Southshore (Stormwind Harbor → Auberdine → Menethil → Southshore). Method also claims a Stormwind Harbor ↔ Auberdine boat. Neither is officially confirmed.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: Skyborne characters can take a portal from Stormwind to Dalaran.

statements.title: Group Finder, travel, lockouts, group rules
statements.text: The Drowned City's instance portal was fixed on 6 Nov. Official sources mention no other dungeon teleports.

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Every dungeon drop was reviewed. Familiar items stay, weak ones were adjusted and new ones added. Hit and crit are unified across melee, ranged and spells. Weapon skill is replaced by Expertise. Healing gear also gets spell power.

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Dungeon set bonuses were rebuilt. Examples: Embrace of the Viper (Wailing Caverns) and Blackened Defias (Deadmines) have new bonuses. New dungeon sets include Rotmender's (Ruins of Lordaeron, cloth), Violet Sorcerer's (City of Dalaran, cloth), Krol'dok Battlegear (Krol'dok Stronghold, plate) and Defias Enforcer's Garb (Alcaz Prison, leather).

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Dungeon Set 1 (tier 0) bonuses now trigger at 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 pieces. The 2-piece bonus is +8 all resistances. The 3-piece bonus is 18 spell power or 30 attack power. Some Spirit has been replaced with spell power, hit or defense.

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Dungeon Set 2 (tier 0.5) exists as a quest upgrade chain that ends with Lord Valthalak.

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Dungeon Set 1 armour types: Magister's, Devout and Dreadmist are cloth. Shadowcraft and Wildheart are leather. Beaststalker and The Elements are mail. Lightforge and Valor are plate.

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Many original dungeon bosses gained new named drops in Forever. Examples: every Stockade boss now drops gear, and Roogug (Razorfen Kraul) now has drops. This is an inference from comparing Method's Forever loot tables with Classic ones.

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Where Dungeon Set 1 pieces drop in Classic: head from Darkmaster Gandling (Scholomance), chest from General Drakkisath (Upper Blackrock Spire), legs from Baron Rivendare (Stratholme Undead). The other pieces vary by class; see KB-73.

statements.title: Loot and itemisation rules relevant to dungeon gear
statements.text: Plate is scarce in the new dungeons up to level 40. The only plate item found from Hall of Thanes through The Drowned City is Phantom Armor from the rare Lordaeron Captain in Ruins of Lordaeron. Plate is common from Krol'dok Stronghold (40–45) onward.

statements.title: Legacy challenges tied to dungeons
statements.text: There are 65 Legacy Challenges at launch, each worth 1 point: Classes 27, Tradeskills 18, PvP 12, Adventure 2, Dungeons 3, Raids 3. A character can spend up to 16 points at launch, and a single character can earn 29.

statements.title: Legacy challenges tied to dungeons
statements.text: The three dungeon challenges each require killing the final boss of every dungeon in one level band: 15–25, 26–45 and 46–60. They are named Novice, Experienced and Master Spelunker.

statements.title: Legacy challenges tied to dungeons
statements.text: Balnazzar (Stratholme) was fixed to count toward Master Spelunker (13 Nov).

statements.title: Legacy challenges tied to dungeons
statements.text: The challenges cover 6, 10 and 17 dungeons respectively, and progress is account-wide.

statements.title: Legacy challenges tied to dungeons
statements.text: No Legacy perk boosts dungeon XP or loot. Well Rested adds about 4% rested XP per rank. Field Medicine doesn't work in dungeons. Thrill of Adventure reportedly doesn't work in dungeons.

statements.title: Legacy challenges tied to dungeons
statements.text: The Adventure challenge "Lord Valthalak Laid to Rest" involves the Upper Blackrock Spire, Lower Blackrock Spire, Scholomance and Stratholme summoning chain.

statements.title: Raids and the dungeons that feed them
statements.text: Barrow Deeps (10 players, 8 bosses), Hyjal Summit (20, 13 bosses) and Onyxia's Lair (40) all open on 9 Dec and reset weekly.

statements.title: Raids and the dungeons that feed them
statements.text: Only Onyxia's Lair has an attunement: the Drakefire Amulet, which must be in your bags (not equipped). Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit list no key or attunement.

statements.title: Raids and the dungeons that feed them
statements.text: Alliance chain for the Onyxia attunement: Dragonkin Menace → The True Masters (6 quests) → Marshal Windsor → Abandoned Hope → A Crumpled Up Note (drops in Blackrock Depths) → A Shred of Hope (kill Argelmach and Angerforge in Blackrock Depths) → Jail Break! (escort in Blackrock Depths) → Stormwind Rendezvous → The Great Masquerade → The Dragon's Eye → Drakefire Amulet. The chain needs the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire.

statements.title: Raids and the dungeons that feed them
statements.text: Horde chain for the Onyxia attunement: Warlord's Command (Lower Blackrock Spire) → For The Horde! (Rend's head) → The Champion of the Horde (Rexxar) → The Testament of Rexxar → Oculus Illusions → Emberstrife → four Test of Skulls quests → Ascension… → Blood of the Black Dragon Champion (Upper Blackrock Spire).

statements.title: Raids and the dungeons that feed them
statements.text: One entrance to Barrow Deeps goes through Blackmaw Hold. The others are via Mount Hyjal and Winterspring.

statements.title: Raids and the dungeons that feed them
statements.text: Molten Core and Blackwing Lair are not in Blizzard's Forever raid list. One guide says Attunement to the Core is unavailable "for now".

statements.title: Should a dungeon be repeated? (cross-dungeon verdict)
statements.text: Mob kills give little XP. Most dungeon XP comes from one-time quests. Once the quests are done, repeat runs give clearly less XP than open-world questing.

statements.title: Should a dungeon be repeated? (cross-dungeon verdict)
statements.text: Doing every dungeon once with its quests is "well worth it". Repeats are mainly for loot.

statements.title: Should a dungeon be repeated? (cross-dungeon verdict)
statements.text: The 8 Nov kill-XP increase was explicitly meant to make repeat runs "feel better". Guidance written before 8 Nov may understate repeat value.

statements.title: Should a dungeon be repeated? (cross-dungeon verdict)
statements.text: Plan two Wailing Caverns runs to finish Deviate Hides and Smart Drinks.

statements.title: Should a dungeon be repeated? (cross-dungeon verdict)
statements.text: Repeat value without XP: Gnomeregan's Sparklematic 5200 (repeatable). Blackmaw Hold's Blackmaw Pouches (Timbermaw reputation) and Feeding Time (herbs, pet). Pix Xizzix's weekly Dire Maul quest. Dire Maul North tribute chest.

statements.title: Should a dungeon be repeated? (cross-dungeon verdict)
statements.text: classic_fallback: Scarlet Monastery Graveyard has the best solo AoE reset spots and a very high XP return. Cathedral is used for mage AoE. Zul'Farrak is one of the best XP grinding spots (graveyard zombies). Maraudon and Sunken Temple work for runs before 50 or 52.

statements.title: Should a dungeon be repeated? (cross-dungeon verdict)
statements.text: classic_fallback: Blackrock Depths Emperor farming (Hand of Justice, Ironfoe), arena runs and lava runs.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Level range 13–18. The dungeon is beneath Ironforge in Dun Morogh. Alliance can walk in from their capital; Horde have to travel into Alliance territory.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: The client Group Finder shows 13–20, minimum level 13, 5 players. Method and Warcraft Tavern also say 13–20. The wiki says 13–18.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: The entrance is inside Ironforge, beneath the High Seat and south-west of the Great Forge: go left past Deliana and down the stairs. The wiki gives coordinates 44.0, 51.8. foreverdb gives 77.1, 51.3, which conflicts.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Alliance travel: Deeprun Tram from Stormwind, or the boat from Auberdine for night elves. Ironforge has a flight master.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Horde travel: a long overland route from the Undercity through Silverpine, Hillsbrad, Arathi, the Wetlands, Loch Modan and Dun Morogh. The wiki calls it ill-advised and suggests taking gear off before entering Ironforge, to limit durability loss when guards kill you. No Horde teleport quest was found.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Run length: median full clear about 38 minutes over 8 recorded runs (best 22:28). Most clears happen at levels 14–18.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Four bosses in a linear layout: Faldrim Anvilmar, Magmatus (the client calls it "Infurnus"), Plunder, Durgen Dirgehammer.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Alliance quests, with Method's XP figures. • Important Heirlooms: Thom Filch, Old Ironforge. 2,950 XP. • The Restless Dead: Afadra Dunwall. 2,300 XP. • Old Ironforge Incursion: Earthseer Farsen, Dun Morogh. 3,200 XP. Needs the Underground Map, which comes from the Dark Iron Map. • The Treaty of Understanding: given inside the dungeon. 2,550 XP. • An Ancient Grudge: given inside the dungeon. 2,300 XP. • Total 13,300 XP.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Horde quests per Method: The Restless Dead and An Ancient Grudge, 4,600 XP in total. foreverdb tags The Restless Dead as Alliance-only, and the wiki lists only An Ancient Grudge as neutral.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Quest levels per the wiki: the chain starts in Kharanos (Farsen's Watch at 13, Underground Map at 15). Dungeon quests are level 15–16.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Quest rewards. • An Ancient Grudge: Catacomb Cloak, or Deepgrave Trousers (leather). • Important Heirlooms: Dwarven Tome (caster off-hand), or Tomb Robber's Gloves (cloth). • Old Ironforge Incursion: Calibrated Blunderbuss (gun), Deepblaze (wand), or Ironforge Greathammer (two-handed mace). • The Restless Dead: Cryptwalker Bracers (mail), or Dusty Belt (leather).

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Aetherwisp Bracers (Faldrim, caster), Robes of the Disgraced Thane (Durgen). • Leather: Flamefist Grips (Magmatus), Direhammer Leggings (Durgen). • Mail: Kindlegem Girdle (Magmatus), Golemguard Chest (Plunder, 80% in a 10-kill sample), Treads of the Protector Golem (Plunder). • Caster: Fang of Magmatus (Intellect dagger), Golemheart Stave. • Healer-leaning: Ephemeral Choker (Spirit neck). • Physical: Spiritwraith Drape (Agility cloak), Durgen's Crescent Axe (Strength). • Plate: none.

statements.title: Hall of Thanes (new, levels 13–18)
statements.text: Testers reported nearly two levels from one run with every quest done.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Level range 15–20. The dungeon is the ruined city above the Undercity, in Tirisfal Glades. Horde enter from the Undercity; Alliance have to cross Horde land.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: The client Group Finder shows 15–22, minimum 15.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon quests require level 15 (3 Nov). "Unending Torment" is offered to Horde from level 15 instead of 16 (6 Nov).

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Entrance: the wiki gives 70.4, 11.4 and Warcraft Tavern gives 72.4, 11.6. Go through the Undercity's front gate, turn left and climb the stairs.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Horde travel: the Undercity flight master. Orcs and trolls take the zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Tirisfal; tauren take the zeppelin from Mulgore.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Alliance travel and safety. • Boats Stormwind → Auberdine → Menethil → Southshore, then overland through Hillsbrad and Silverpine (or swim across Lordamere Lake). • Alliance get flagged for PvP near the Undercity. • Leave on foot rather than hearthing, because the Alliance quests hand in at the entrance.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Bosses. • Witherfang. • The Baron (the client calls it "The Butcher"). • Viktor the Vile (optional: click the fireplace, he appears on the 6th wave). • The Abandoned (optional: at the statue, appears on the 4th wave). • Bjork. • Rath'mael (final boss). • Lordaeron Captain (rare, hostile to Horde only).

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Horde quests (Method XP figures): • The Wrath of Rath'mael: Deathguard Kristof, Tirisfal. 4,600 XP. Choice of Forsaken Greataxe (Strength) or Gnarled Necromancer's Staff (caster). • A Frightened Request: Tabitha Heartweaver, Silverpine. 4,600 XP. Choice of Edward's Knife (Agility) or Tabitha's Cuffs (cloth). • Light's Justice: Morbin Lightbane, Undercity. 4,600 XP. Choice of Spare Part Bindings (leather) or The Stitcher (caster mace). • The New Plague: Theodore Griffs, Undercity, after the "A Recipe For Death" chain. 5,450 XP. Choice of Blight Gloves (cloth) or Plaguefang (melee). • Unending Torment: starts from an item The Baron drops. 3,450 XP. Has follow-ups via Master Apothecary Faranell. • Crest of Lordaeron: starts from a random item inside. 6,200 XP. • Total: 28,900 XP.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Alliance quests (Method XP figures): • Crest of Lordaeron: hand in to Lady Dena Kennedy. 6,200 XP. • Abominable Creatures: Captain Truman at the entrance. 3,900 XP. Choice of Grave Shroud, Monstrous Cleaver or Slain Baron's Signet. • Bloodied Insignia: dropped by skeletons, hand in to General Marcus Jonathan. 6,200 XP. Choice of Duty Bound Leggings (leather) or Remembrance Armor (mail). • Remember That I Love You: a letter found near Rath'mael. 6,200 XP. Part 2 rewards the Tarnished Locket. • Total: 22,500 XP.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Notable drops by armour type and role. • Cloth: Rotmender's set (Leggings from The Abandoned, Treads from Rath'mael, Garb, Gloves and Sash from trash), Leftover Abomination Skin (Baron), Tuskwrap Belt (Bjork). • Leather: Witherbite Bracers, Bloodied Chestwraps. • Mail: Atrophic Girdle, Abomination Bones, Vilewalkers, Grip of Fear, Bonerust Leggings, Death Bindings (trash). • Plate: Phantom Armor (rare Lordaeron Captain only). • Caster: Scepter of the Abandoned, Coldspire Staff. • Tank: Mirror of Rath'mael (Strength shield). • Physical: Segmented Spider Leg (Agility staff), Corpse Chopper, Haunting Blade, Meathook Slicer.

statements.title: Ruins of Lordaeron (new, levels 15–20)
statements.text: Testers reported about two levels from one full-quest run.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Level range 24–29. The dungeon is above Whelgar's Excavation, near Thelgen Rock and Dun Algaz. Inside are titan constructs and a time-frozen area.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: The 1 Oct beta notes listed this dungeon as 26–31.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: The client Group Finder shows 26–33. Method and Warcraft Tavern also say 26–33. The wiki says 26–32, with quests from level 24 and a level-31 final boss.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Entrance: the summoning stone is at 53.4, 65.3, reached through Whelgar's site. foreverdb gives 24.5, 73.4, which conflicts.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Alliance: use the Menethil Harbor flight path, or come overland from Loch Modan via Thelsamar. Horde: come south from Hammerfall (Arathi) over the Thandol Span.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Run length: 20–35 minutes (Method); median about 31 minutes over 7 runs, best 22:06 (foreverdb).

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Bosses: Saltspine, Shadetooth, Highland Horror (Alliance quest boss, no gear), Relic Guardian (final). The Relic Guardian drops the Titan Relic quest item.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Alliance quests: • Songblade Search: Dorin Songblade, Lakeshire. 6,150 XP. Leads to Fallen in the Fen: Daewyn's Girdle (cloth) or Songblade Stabilizer (mail). • Seeking Caitlin: Llana, Astranaar. Leads to Lost in the Thicket Things (Caitlin, Menethil, 4,900 XP), then Heartwoven: Satchel of Potions (trinket). • Highland Hides: James Halloran, Menethil. 1,150 XP. • Horrors in the Highland: Rethiel the Greenwarden. 6,150 XP. Curl of Life (caster ring), Hornbeam Heft or Ironwood Destroyer (caster two-hander). • Lost Relic Carry: starts from the Titan Relic. 1,150 XP. Leads to Prehistoric Prism (Prospector Whelgar): Explorer's League Dustcover, Healer's Staff or Heavehammer. • Total: 19,500 XP (Method).

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Horde quests: • Changing Tastes: Borstan, Orgrimmar. 6,950 XP. Satchel of Potions or Serrated Raptor Claw (Agility). • Dragonmaw Rumors (Zaruk, Hammerfall) leads to Open the Maw (Deathstalker Agent). 6,950 XP. Dirt-Heavy Bracers (leather) or Knife-Polishing Rag (cloth). • Elder Knowledge: starts from the Titan Relic. 1,400 XP. Leads to Earthen Echo: Furs of the Earthen Ring, Healer's Staff or Heavehammer. • Total: 15,300 XP. Method's totals leave out some follow-up quests, so the real totals are probably higher.

statements.title: Excavation Site: Wetlands (new, levels 24–29)
statements.text: Drops: • Cloth: Glinteye Slippers (Saltspine). • Leather: Supple Bellyskin Leggings (Saltspine), Garb of Florid Feathers (Shadetooth). • Mail: Saltscale Girdle (Saltspine), Raptorclaw Greaves (Shadetooth), Reliquary Mantle (Relic Guardian). • Caster: Raptor's Gaze (off-hand), Ring of Power Regulation. • Physical: Golemsight Long Gun (Agility). • Recipe: Blueprint: Rock Garden. • Plate: none.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Level range 28–33, Alterac Mountains. You must earn the Kirin Tor's trust before entering, and you go in through the sewers. Alliance start with "An Alarming Request" (Emissary Jacques, Southshore). Horde start with "Key to the City" and "Prison Break-In" (Magus Wordeen Voidglare, Tarren Mill).

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: The client Group Finder shows 28–35, minimum 28. Clear times: median about 56 minutes over 6 runs (best 37:01). Most clears are at levels 31–34.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Method estimates 30–40 minutes for a full run. Its page dates from beta (15 Oct) and contradicts itself on level range (28–35 vs 26–33).

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: The wiki gives 28–34, quests from 24, final boss level 31. The summoning stone and instance entrance are at 8, 61, at the sewer grate on Dalaran's west wall. At least one party member needs the **Dalaran Sewer Key**.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Only Horde need the attunement. Horde quests require level 30. The Sewer Key comes from the Image of Archmage Modera through "Heart of Disruption", and one Horde keyholder per group is enough.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: foreverdb lists a separate Alliance entrance through a gated tunnel in the Underbelly that needs no key. The nearest Horde flight path is The Sepulcher. Modera's image is on the south shore of Lordamere Lake, at Silverpine 68.6, 45.1.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Alliance attunement chain. • An Alarming Request: requires level 30, quest level 33. Hand in to Modera's image. 660 XP and +10 Kirin Tor reputation. • It unlocks Heart of Disruption (Alliance): loot an Arcane Mote from the last boss. Choice of Defender of Dalaran (Str/Int two-handed mace), Renewing Footpads (leather) or Spellguard Pauldrons (mail). • Then Friend of the Kirin Tor, and Starving Arcane: Arcane Infused Rod (caster off-hand) or Fallen Guard's Pendant (Strength). • Power Overwhelming: High Sorcerer Andromath, Stormwind. Runebound Gloves (leather) or Violet Sash (cloth). • A Green Sample: Shylamiir, Stormwind. Thorn Protecting Girdle (mail) or Vine Pruner's Cloak (caster).

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Horde attunement chain. • Prison Break In and Key to the City (rewards the Grimy Key). • Then Dalaran Patrols, then Blood in the Streets, then Heart of Disruption (Horde). Heart of Disruption rewards the Sewer Key plus a choice of Battle Spaulders (mail), Enchanted Sandals (cloth) or Striking Staff (Str/Int). • Then Shrewd Negotiations. • Source of Power: Doctor Martin Felben, Undercity. Construct Cloak (Strength) or Unstable Power Core (wand). • The Grave Knight: Melisara, Tarren Mill. Gravewalker Boots (leather) or Undead Knight's Bracers (mail). • Opportunistic Education: Rexxie Copperclutch, inside. Larcenist's Belt (leather) or Solid Gold Band (caster).

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Dungeon quests total about 15,800 XP per faction.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Bosses and drops. • Atrexis: Graveweave Bindings (cloth), Bonebinder's Signet (Strength), Gravespike Repeater. • Arcane Anomaly: Mana-Warped Chain Shirt (mail), Ephemeral Grips (cloth), Runemender's Seal (caster). • Arcanic Enigma (the client calls it "Mana Elemental"): Drape of Shifting Energy (attack power), Violet Sorcerer's Robes (cloth), Wand of Mana Concentration. • Unstable Sentinel: Guardian's Dualblade (tank-ish), Refractory Scaleguards (mail), Unstable Crystalline Shoulderpads (leather), Blueprint: Spinning Wheel. • Fel Ancient: Blightleaf Rope (cloth), Garb of Fallen Felbark (leather), Felbough Arm (Agility polearm). • Mana Devourer: Manascale Treads (mail), Slitherwrap Girdle (leather), Spine of the Devourer (caster staff). • Shade of the Archmage (final): Archmagister's Faceted Pendant, Ponderous Orb (caster off-hand), Violet Sorcerer's Mantle (cloth), Arcane Mote, Blueprint: Arcane Salvager. • Plate: none. Violet Sorcerer's pieces form a cloth caster set.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Secret boss Lyn the Ignored: Bonepile Gaze (Strength shield, tank), Cartilage Shapers (leather), Tendonscraper Dagger (caster). To unlock him, take the Black Tome from Arugal's room in Shadowfang Keep and use it at the ley line in the Ambermill town hall (Silverpine).

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: The client also lists a "Mana Wraith" encounter. No loot data exists for it.

statements.title: City of Dalaran (new, levels 28–33)
statements.text: Tip: Warrior and Paladin tanks cannot block Saturated Remnant melee. Most trash damage is arcane.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Level range 35–40, off the Stranglethorn coast west of Grom'gol. The entrance is underwater. It is an open-air dungeon that turns stormy before the final fight.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: The wiki gives 35–42, quests from 30, final boss level 40. Its coordinates are 21, 28: underwater, south of the Haunted Isle. Warcraft Tavern also gives 35–42, with the entrance near 21.4, 27.9 (past the Vile Reef, then a cavern with a large tablet).

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Travel: Horde fly to Grom'gol. Alliance fly to Booty Bay, with Darkshire the next nearest flight path.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Bring a Warlock or Shaman for water breathing. A clear takes 30–40 minutes. There are 6 bosses plus 2 possible rares.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Hotfixes: • 6 Nov: the instance portal and creature leashing fixed. • 9 Nov: creatures were dealing about 30% too much damage (fixed), and the Deathless Marrow encounter was nerfed (25% less health). • 13 Nov: trash now respawns after 2 hours instead of 1. • 16 Nov: Captain Dreadrise can now be stunned; Pyromancer Braxton fixed.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Bosses and drops. • Zul'Alai (37): Berserker Shackles (mail), Oathbound Bracers (leather), Bloodslash Axe (Strength). • Var'Taka (38): Harpoon of Command (tank polearm), Brinebelly Leggings (leather), Priestess Cloak (Intellect). • Captain Dreadrise (38): Briny Sash (cloth), Dreadfrost Saber, Frosty Blunderbuss. • Deathless Marrow (39): Bloodspine Staff (caster), Knucklebone Ring (melee), Viscera Spaulders (mail). • Primeval Elemental (38, underwater): Heart of the Primeval (caster trinket), Robe of the Drowned (cloth), Waterlogged Burial Shroud. The wiki adds Linken's Boots of Iron (mail). • Min'loth the Serpent (40, final): Maw of Min'loth (tank shield), Ritual-Binder's Gloves (leather), Serpentbane Crown (mail). • Rare Umbra: Deep-Dweller's Grips (cloth), Umbral Scaled Belt (mail). • Rare Gill: Tidebound Dagger (caster), Gill's Gills (attack power trinket). • Plate: none.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Alliance quests. • Magics of the Drowned City and Take Two With Water: Loremaster Dibbs, Southshore (level 30, after the Rebel Camp / Dalaran chain). • Ancient Gurubashi Secrets: Archmage Timear, Dalaran. Quest level conflicts: 34 or 40.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Horde quests. • The Drowned City: Kin'weelay, Grom'gol, level 30. Take rubbings of four tablets. +100 Darkspear and +100 Orgrimmar reputation. • The Only Good Brinescale...: Commander Aggro'gosh. Tidesoaked Leggings (leather) or Naga Priestess's Mantle (cloth). • Ancient Gurubashi Idol: Mazu'kon, Mulgore.

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: Quests for both factions (Krazek, Booty Bay). • Shady Saltseers: Rusted Troll War Belt (mail) or Saltseer's Helm (leather). • The Saltseer Captain: Mutinous Cuffs (cloth) or South Seas Shroud (tank cloak).

statements.title: The Drowned City (new, levels 35–40)
statements.text: No quest XP figures were found. foreverdb has no client data for this dungeon.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: Level range 40–45, 5 players, in Riverglades. At BlizzCon it was shown as 40–55; Blizzard corrected it to 40–45.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: Warcraft Tavern and the wiki's main article give 40–47, minimum 40.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: Riverglades travel (see KB-01, row 14). • Alliance: Lakeshire road north, right fork into the Bristle Hills, then Farholde Keep. • Horde: boat Steamwheedle Port → Powderfuse Port → Rog'mar, or walk in from the Badlands.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: The entrance is a cave beside the closed main gates. Coordinates conflict: 39, 39 or 37.5, 37.5. A spirit healer is just outside.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: A full clear takes about 40–50 minutes. The layout is a mostly linear road.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: Bosses: Slavecrusher Grox, Twilight Commander Zarmok, War Handler Ashka, Nar'gurk, Bossman Toof, Overlord Mugg (final). The mini-boss Tunk drops the Krol'dok Moulding quest starter.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: Alliance quests ("level (available from)"): • Vengeance of the Highborne: Ranath Nightstride, Dalaran. 45 (37). 11,500 XP. • Twilight Mementos chain: Sergeant Riftan, Twilight's Shroud. 10,200 + 3,450 + 3,450 XP. Ends with the Curio-Adorned Necklace (caster). • Tome of Twilight: Ashe Amberhall, Farholde Keep. Requires "A Small Favor". 11,050 XP. Twilight Initiate's Belt (leather) or Torn Cultist Cloak. • Eye of Mugg: Demar Brant, after the Farholde chains. 11,500 XP. Rock on Stick (Strength one-handed mace), Bigger Rock on Bigger Stick (Strength two-handed mace) or Stick No Rock (caster staff). • Krol'dok Moulding: from Tunk, hand in to Alphonse Dumas. 3,300 XP. Leads to Key Ingredients: bring **4 Thick Leather and 12 Iron Bar**, 3,300 XP, rewards the Krol'dok Compound Key.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: Horde quests: • A Token of Vengeance: Da'grosh, outside. 15 Cultist Ears. 8,200 XP. • Tome of Twilight: Tran'gul, Rog'mar. 11,050 XP. Indoctrinated Choker or Convert's Bindings (cloth). • Eye of Mugg: Krom'rosh. 11,500 XP. Same weapon choice as Alliance. • Moulding and Key Ingredients: turned in to Kreza Darkthorn. • The Horde quests require progress in Krom'rosh's chain.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)
statements.text: Quest XP sums (my arithmetic from wow.gg): about 57,750 Alliance and about 37,350 Horde.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)

These form the Krol'dok Battlegear set. • Caster: Shadowlight Athame, Band of Bossman. • Physical: Bloodied Gutslicer, Mugg's Jabber / Mugg's Crosser, Emblem of Slamming, Chain of the Corruptor. • Tank: Zarmok's Plated Signet. • Recipe: Blueprint: Expert Campfire.

statements.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (new, levels 40–45)

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: Level range 48–53, on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. Inside are Defias and naga, and the lore ties it to King Varian's imprisonment.

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: The wiki says 5 players, quests from 48, final boss level 51. Warcraft Tavern's list says 48–55.

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: No key or attunement. Alliance fly to Theramore; Horde fly to Brackenwall Village. Both then ride to the north-east shore and swim to the island.

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: The portal is in the basement of the old tower, around 75, 14. From the dock, take the left path up the hill. The Overseer's Keyring (dropped by Overseer Wrex) opens the lower floor.

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: Bosses: The Questioner, Tidemistress Ca'zass, Overseer Wrex, Katerina the Cleaner, Blazeroar (Zarla Ober). **Tip:** skip The Questioner on the way in. Otherwise Mason Connery won't offer "The Man in the Iron Chains".

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: Alliance quests. • Chain from Mathias Shaw (Stormwind): Our Man in Theramore → Watch Yer Back → The Return of the King? → The Secret Prison. • A Bit of Wet Work: Sully McCleary. Marshdweller's Pants, Naga Scale Spaulders or Theramore Defender's Gauntlets. • The Dragon's Journal: Archmage Lan'dalock, Dalaran. 14,400 XP per CC. • Shaw Needs to Know: Courier's Clasp, Dustwallow Dirk or Fatebound Buckler.

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: Horde quests. • Chain from Eitrigg (Orgrimmar): The Missing Kor'kron → The Elite of the Elite → Right Place, Wrong Time → No Orc Left Behind. **Pick up No Orc Left Behind from Sergeant Ulka, outside the tower at about 70.4, 19.0.** • XP per CC: No Orc Left Behind 12,463; The Honor of the Kor'kron 12,463; Bad News for Folkar 2,472; Thrall Needs to Know 2,472; Blood Red Bandanas 9,700. • A Little Payback: Ulka. Rewards include Kor'kron Battle Gauntlets. • Horde total roughly 30–40k XP.

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: Neutral quest chain inside: The Man in the Iron Chains (Mason Connery; Ornate Shackle Key from The Questioner; 2,850 XP) → More Valuable Than Gold → State Secrets.

statements.title: Alcaz Prison (new, levels 48–53)
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Beastbond Robe. • Leather: Defias Enforcer's Shoulderpads and Legguards (part of a 5-piece Defias Enforcer's Garb set). • Mail: Seascale Bracers, Cutthroat Chestguard. • Plate: Girdle of Extracted Answers, Grips of Control. • Caster: Tidesong Wand, Zarla's Snack Pouch (trinket). • Tank: Fingerbreaker Stamp (trinket), Fatebound Buckler (quest reward). • Physical: Alcaz Willcrusher, Wrex's Pinky Ring, Katerina's Shanker, Sentimental Locket, Cloak of the Tidemistress.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: Level range 55–60. A furbolg city in Azshara behind a long-sealed gate, with several routes and a deep path further down.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: One entrance to the Barrow Deeps raid goes through Blackmaw Hold.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: The wiki says 5 players, quests from 45, final boss level 57.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: Entrance. • The tunnel is at about 38.7, 33.4 in northern Azshara, at the old furbolg gate. A meeting stone sits beside it. • The portal is at the end of the tunnel, near the Winterspring border. • Horde fly to Valormok. Alliance fly to Talrendis Point.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: Several quests need Neutral standing with Timbermaw. To raise it, kill Deadwood furbolgs in Felwood.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: Layout and bosses. • Areas: Blackmaw Grove (Withermaw), Festering Grotto, Bonesnout's Thicket (kill 4 ritualists first), then a bridge into the hold. • Bosses: Unbound Spirit, Elder Shaman Bloodmane, Blackmaw Behemoth with Clawbert, then Varrox Bleakhoof (final, guards the Barrow Deeps entrance). Impaan the Imprisoner is at Defiled Peak. • Rares: Moontouched Wanderer, Gortek the Apprentice, Tunnelweb Matriarch. • A Slow Fall jump from a ledge skips much of the hold.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: Quests. Each line is "quest level / available from"; XP figures come from CC (low confidence). • Beneath Nordrassil (lead-in). • Get to the Roots of It (55/45, 11,300 XP): Nara Wildmane, Thunder Bluff (Horde) or Mathrengyl Bearwalker, Darnassus (Alliance). • Blackmaw Magic (59/52, 16,100 H / 12,800 A): Muln Earthfury, Mulgore (Horde) or Archmage Timear, Dalaran (Alliance). • Claws That Rend, Tusks That Gore (58/45, 12,400): Ogtink, Azshara. Great Bear Claw, Staff of Wild Beasts (caster) or Wild Malleus. • The Twin Bears (55/47, 11,300): Lorekeeper Nok, Ursolan. Guidance of Ursoc (Strength cloak) or Wisdom of Ursol (caster cloak). • Blackmaw Reclamation (60/47, 13,200): Gatekeeper Rageroar, Ursolan. Item-level 62 blue rings: Ouroboros Ring (tank), Eagle's Head Signet, Malefactor's End (caster) or Engraved Band (Strength). • Blackmaw Pouches (60/55, 13,200): Ekkal, Ruins of Eldarath. Repeatable afterwards for Timbermaw reputation. • A Lost Memento (item-started): Nama's Cherished Necklace. • Feeding Time (repeatable): herbs, with a chance at a pet.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: Quest XP totals per CC's tables: about 88,800 Horde and 85,500 Alliance. The same page's intro says about 40k Horde and 37k Alliance.

statements.title: Blackmaw Hold (new, levels 55–60)
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Robes of Dark Summons (Impaan), Cowl of Dark Ambition (Unbound Spirit). • Leather: Withering Grips (caster), Veilpiercer Girdle (tank), Horns of Varrox. • Mail: Impish Chain Hood, Shamanic Wristguards, Blackmaw Chain Belt. • Plate: Spike Crested Bracers (Bonesnout), Bleak Eye Shoulderplates (Varrox), Burnished Pridescales, Octofinger Gauntlets (rare). • Tank: Bloodfur Bulwark (shield), Lucky Shovelnose Tuft (trinket). • Physical: Tuskblade Halberd, Flameslash Crescent, Bloody Claws of Attack, Flamebreak Talisman, Behemoth Bones, Claymore of Two Moons. • Healer: Fist of Revelation (rare drop, seen once). • Recipes: Pattern: Timbermaw Tunic, Plans: Breastplate of Salvation.

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
statements.text: Level range 58–60, in the northern hills of Un'Goro Crater. You bring power crystals gathered in Un'Goro and use them at consoles inside.

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
statements.text: The entrance is on the hill above Marshal's Refuge, around 48.1, 6.1. A meeting stone stands at the stairs. Mounts work inside.

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
statements.text: Both factions use the Marshal's Refuge flight path, or Gadgetzan as a fallback. No key is needed.

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
statements.text: There are four Archival Panel consoles: Red, Blue, Green and Yellow. • Each panel needs 15 crystals of its own colour, so 60 crystals in total. • Each panel summons one boss: Red → Cinder, Yellow → Bolt, Blue → Snowtalon. Green → Vitrix is unconfirmed. • Activating all four unlocks the Titan Panel, which summons Nanaya, the final boss. • Crystals can also be farmed inside.

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
statements.text: Bosses: Titanosaur, Venomridge, Thunderhoof, Direhorn Matriarch, Izha'Rel and Tor'Rel, Cinder, Bolt, Vitrix, Snowtalon, Nanaya.

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
statements.text: Horde quests (all level 60, available from 55; XP from CC). • Crystalline Elements: Mayena Earthseeker, Mulgore. 17,650 XP. • Essence of Seeping Slimes: Chemist Fuely, Undercity. 17,650 XP. • The Dark Crystal: Faranell. 6,600 XP. • Total: 41,900 XP.

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)

statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
