statements.title: Shaper's Terrace (new, levels 58–60)
statements.text: The Warcraft Wiki has no instance page. Its "The Shaper's Terrace (quest)" page is about an unrelated quest from a later expansion. Do not use it.

statements.title: Ragefire Chasm
statements.text: Level range 13–18 (Method). The wiki lists 13–19.

statements.title: Ragefire Chasm
statements.text: The entrance is in the Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar. In practice it is Horde-only: there are no Alliance quests and no teleport.

statements.title: Ragefire Chasm
statements.text: Quests come from all three Horde capitals. • Thunder Bluff, Rahauro: Testing an Enemy's Strength; Searching for the Lost Satchel, followed by Returning the Lost Satchel. • Orgrimmar: Slaying the Beast (Neeru Fireblade); Hidden Enemies (Thrall, a 5-part chain that starts from a Skull Rock insignia). • Undercity: The Power to Destroy… (Varimathras). • Method's Forever XP: 2,950 / 2,150 / 4,750 / 2,350 / 2,350, total 14,550.

statements.title: Ragefire Chasm
statements.text: Pick up the Wailing Caverns quests in Thunder Bluff and the Shadowfang Keep and Ruins of Lordaeron quests in the Undercity on the same trip.

statements.title: Ragefire Chasm
statements.text: Bosses: Oggleflint, Taragaman the Hungerer, Jergosh the Invoker, Bazzalan.

statements.title: Ragefire Chasm
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Robe of Evocation (caster), Crystalline Cuffs. • Leather: Chasm Walkers. • Mail: Cavedweller Bracers. • Physical: Trogg Scepter, Barbaric Crossbow, Bone Knuckles, Cursed Felblade, Chanting Blade, Searing Dagger. • Cloaks: Subterranean Cape, Satyrskin Cloak. • Oggleflint and Bazzalan had no named drops in Classic.

statements.title: Ragefire Chasm
statements.text: Level requirement 10, recommended 14–18. Rewards: Returning the Lost Satchel gives Featherbead or Savannah Bracers. The Power to Destroy gives Ghastly Trousers, Dredgemire Leggings or Gargoyle Leggings. Hidden Enemies gives the Kris, Hammer, Axe or Staff of Orgrimmar.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Level range 15–24. Non-linear, 9 bosses, a clear takes 30–40 minutes.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: The entrance is the cave by the Forgotten Pools in the Barrens. • Horde arrive naturally while levelling; Undead take the zeppelin to Durotar. • Alliance either swim from Westfall to Booty Bay and take the boat to Ratchet, or take the boat from Menethil to Theramore.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Bosses: Lady Anacondra, Kresh, Lord Cobrahn, Deviate Faerie Dragon (rare), Lord Pythas, Skum, Lord Serpentis, Verdan the Everliving, Mutanus. Mutanus needs the Naralex escort after all four Fanglords are dead.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Horde-only quests: Serpentbloom (Apothecary Zamah, Thunder Bluff) and Leaders of the Fang (after a 6-quest chain from the Crossroads; hand in to Nara Wildmane).

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Quests for both factions. • Deviate Hides and Deviate Eradication: from the alcove above the entrance. • Trouble at the Docks and Smart Drinks: from Ratchet. • The Glowing Shard: drops from Mutanus. Turn in to Hamuul Runetotem (Horde) or Mathrengyl Bearwalker (Alliance).

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Method's Forever XP: Serpentbloom 3,300; Leaders of the Fang 4,300; Smart Drinks 2,650; Trouble at the Docks 2,650; Deviate Eradication 3,100; Deviate Hides 4,000; Glowing Shard 7,150. Totals: 27,150 Horde, 19,550 Alliance.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Deviate Hides paid about 1,600 XP in Classic and about 4,650 before 1 Oct. That implies about 3,125 after the cut.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Drops. • Leather: Embrace of the Viper set, which has a new set bonus. Pieces: Serpent's Shoulders and Belt of the Fang (Anacondra), Leggings (Cobrahn), Armor (Pythas), Footpads (Serpentis). • Cloth: Robe of the Moccasin, Slither Cord, Serpent Gloves, Slime-encrusted Pads. • Mail: Cobrahn's Grasp, Savage Trodders, Mutant Scale Breastplate. • Tank: Worn Turtle Shell Shield, Kresh's Back, Seedcloud Buckler. • Caster: Living Root (staff), Firebelcher (wand). • Physical: Stinging Viper, Tail Spike, Night Watch Shortsword, Venomstrike.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Plan for more than one run, because Deviate Hides and Smart Drinks often don't finish in one.

statements.title: Wailing Caverns
statements.text: Rewards. • Serpentbloom: Apothecary Gloves. • Leaders of the Fang: Crescent Staff or Wingblade. • Deviate Eradication: Dagmire Gauntlets, Deviate Scale Belt pattern or Sizzle Stick. • Deviate Hides: Deviate Hide Pack or Slick Deviate Leggings. • Glowing Shard follow-up: Quagmire Galoshes or Talbar Mantle. • Classic level requirement 10, recommended 17–24.

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Level range 17–26. A clear takes 20–30 minutes. 8 encounters, including the rare Miner Johnson.

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: The entrance is in Moonbrook, Westfall. Alliance fly to Sentinel Hill. Horde take the zeppelin to Grom'gol, then swim north.

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Bosses: Rhahk'Zor, Miner Johnson (rare), Sneed's Shredder / Sneed, Gilnid, Mr. Smite, Cookie, Captain Greenskin, Edwin VanCleef.

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Forever adds one new quest chain: Testing the Wells → Destruction in Deadmines (Alba Fairmoon, Sentinel Hill; place explosives at the forge near Gilnid).

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Alliance quests. • Stormwind: Collecting Memories and Oh Brother… (Wilder Thistlenettle); Underground Assault (Shoni). • Sentinel Hill: Red Silk Bandanas (Scout Riell); The Defias Brotherhood (Gryan Stoutmantle, kill VanCleef). • The Unsent Letter: drops from VanCleef, hand in to Baros Alexston. It leads into The Stockade Riots.

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Wowhead's Forever page for The Defias Brotherhood still lists the Chausses, Tunic and Staff of Westfall and 200 Stormwind reputation.

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Drops. • Leather: Blackened Defias Belt and Armor (the set has a new bonus), Smelting Pants. • Cloth: Ogre Loincloth, Corsair's Overshirt. • Caster: Cookie's Stirring Rod, Emberstone Staff. • Physical: Smite's Mighty Hammer, Cruel Barb, Thief's Blade, and others. • Tank: Gold-plated Buckler. • Trinket: Lookie's Spyglass. • Recipes: Blueprint: Anvil, Blueprint: Cookie's Feast.

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Player measurement: VanCleef's turn-in gives 6,175 XP (2,600 in Classic).

statements.title: The Deadmines
statements.text: Rewards. • Collecting Memories: Dusty Mining Gloves or Tunneler's Boots. • Oh Brother: Miner's Revenge. • Underground Assault: Polar Gauntlets or Sable Wand. • Red Silk Bandanas: Piercing Axe, Scrimshaw Dagger or Solid Shortblade. • Classic recommended level 18–24.

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: Level range 20–30. A clear takes 20–30 minutes.

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: Travel. • Horde: the nearest flight path is The Sepulcher. • Alliance: Method's directions are confused; it mentions Menethil and Southshore.

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: Bosses: Rethilgore, Razorclaw, Baron Silverlaine, Commander Springvale, Odo, Deathsworn Captain (rare), Fenrus, Wolf Master Nandos, Archmage Arugal.

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: The regular quests are Horde-only and shareable, and none of them is part of a chain, so pick all three up together. • Deathstalkers in Shadowfang: High Executor Hadrec. • The Book of Ur: Keeper Bel'dugur. The book is in Fenrus' room. • Arugal Must Die: Dalar Dawnweaver.

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: Class quests inside the dungeon. • The Horn of Xelthos: Rogue, carried over from Season of Discovery. • The Orb of Soran'ruk: Warlock. • The Test of Righteousness: Paladin.

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: The Black Tome in Arugal's room unlocks the secret boss in City of Dalaran (see KB-13).

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Robes and Belt of Arugal, Blindwatcher's Sight, Feline Mantle, Bloody Apron. • Leather: Rugged Spaulders, Girdle of the Blindwatcher, Black Wolf Bracers, Worgpelt Leggings. • Mail: Phantom Armor (rare drop), Half-Eaten Boots. • Tank: Commander's Crest. • Caster: Odo's Ley Staff, Meteor Shard, Sorcerer Collar. • Physical: Blade of Silverlaine, Cell Keeper's Claws, Butcher's Slicer, Arced War Axe, Haunting Blade. • Trinket: Worgenbane Talisman.

statements.title: Shadowfang Keep
statements.text: Rewards: Ghostly Mantle; Grizzled Boots or Steel-clasped Bracers; Seal of Sylvanas. Classic XP 2,000 / 2,100 / 3,300. Classic level requirement 14, recommended 22–30.

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Level range 24–32. A clear takes 25–35 minutes. Linear, 6 bosses. Zoram Strand, Ashenvale.

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Alliance travel from Auberdine. Method says Forever adds a boat from Stormwind Harbor to Auberdine. Horde use the Zoram'gar flight path.

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Bosses: Ghamoo-ra, Lady Sarevess, Gelihast, Old Serra'kis, Twilight Lord Kelris, Aku'mai. Baron Aquanis is summoned for a quest.

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Alliance quests. • Darnassus: In Search of Thaelrid; Twilight Falls. • Ironforge: Knowledge in the Deeps. • Auberdine: Researching the Corruption. • Inside: Blackfathom Villainy (Head of Kelris).

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Horde quests. • Allegiance to the Old Gods: starts from a Damp Note; hand in to Je'neu at Zoram'gar. • The Essence of Aku'mai: 20 sapphires, collected outside the dungeon. • Amongst the Ruins and Baron Aquanis. • Blackfathom Villainy: hand in to Bashana Runetotem.

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Class quests: The Orb of Soran'ruk (Warlock), The Test of Righteousness (Paladin).

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Ghamoo-ra's Bind, Gaze Dreamer Pants, Leech Pants. • Leather: Naga Battle Gloves, Bands of Serra'kis, Moss Cinch. • Mail: Tortoise Armor, Algae Fists, Twilight Lord Girdle. • Caster: Rod of the Sleepwalker. • Physical: Darkwater Talwar, Naga Heartpiercer, Strike of the Hydra, Bite of Serra'kis. • Trinket: Cursed Murloc Eye.

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: 9 Nov hotfix: a bug that blocked releasing your spirit in Blackfathom Deeps was fixed.

statements.title: Blackfathom Deeps
statements.text: Rewards. • Twilight Falls: Heartwood Girdle or Nimbus Boots. • Knowledge in the Deeps: Sustaining Ring. • Researching the Corruption: Beetle Clasps or Prelacy Cape. • Allegiance to the Old Gods: Band of the Fist or Chestnut Mantle. • Baron Aquanis: Outlaw Sabre or Witch's Finger. • Blackfathom Villainy: Arctic Buckler or Gravestone Scepter. • Classic level requirement 15, recommended 20–30.

statements.title: The Stockade
statements.text: Level range 24–32. A clear takes 15–25 minutes. 5 bosses plus a rare. In the Stormwind canals. Alliance-only in practice.

statements.title: The Stockade
statements.text: Warcraft Tavern says it has barely changed from Classic apart from the loot.

statements.title: The Stockade
statements.text: Bosses: Targorr the Dread, Dextren Ward, Kam Deepfury, Hamhock, Bazil Thredd, Bruegal Ironknuckle (rare).

statements.title: The Stockade
statements.text: Quests. • What Comes Around…: Lakeshire. • Crime and Punishment: Darkshire. • Quell the Uprising: Warden Thelwater. • The Color of Blood: Nikova Raskol. • The Fury Runs Deep: Dun Modr; needs The Dark Iron War first. • The Stockade Riots: needs the Unsent Letter from the Deadmines.

statements.title: The Stockade
statements.text: Every boss now has gear. In Classic, only Kam and Bruegal did. • Leather: Blackrock Harness, Executioner Mantle, Demolition Girdle, Defias Jailbreakers. • Cloth: Bridgebreaker Bindings. • Mail: Ogre Grips, Jimmied Handcuffs. • Tank: Repurposed Rack (shield). • Caster and feral: Kam's Walking Stick. • Physical: Graverobber's Shovel, Boneslicer, Hamhock's Cleaver, Debt Collector, and others.

statements.title: The Stockade
statements.text: Rewards. • What Comes Around: Hardened Root Staff or Lucine Longsword. • Crime and Punishment: Ambassador's Boots or Darkshire Mail Leggings. • The Fury Runs Deep: Belt of Vindication or Headbasher. • The Riots chain ends with the Seal of Wrynn. • Classic level requirement 15, recommended 22–30.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Level range 29–38. A clear takes 30–40 minutes. 6 bosses. Western Dun Morogh.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Alliance arrive by tram to Ironforge. The back entrance needs the Workshop Key, which drops from Electrocutioner 6000.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Horde travel: the chain Rig Wars → Chief Engineer Scooty → Gnomer-gooooone! gives a Goblin Transponder that teleports you from Booty Bay to the Gnomeregan entrance. Scooty will replace a lost transponder.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Bosses: Grubbis, Viscous Fallout, Electrocutioner 6000, Crowd Pummeler 9-60, Dark Iron Ambassador (rare), Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Alliance quests. • Save Techbot's Brain! • Gnogaine → The Only Cure is More Green Glow (2-hour time limit). • Data Rescue. • Essential Artificials. • Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators. • The Grand Betrayal.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Horde and neutral quests. • Horde: Rig Wars. • Neutral: A Fine Mess (escort). • Neutral: Grime-Encrusted Ring → The Sparklematic 5200!, which is repeatable and its boxes can contain bind-on-equip gear.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Acidic Walkers, Spidertank Oilrag, Electromagnetic Gigaflux Reactivator. • Leather: Skullduggery Belt, Gnomebot Operating Boots, Emissary Cuffs. • Mail: Grubbis Paws. • Tank: Irradiated Shield, Thermaplugg's Central Core. • Caster: Hydrocane, Royal Diplomatic Scepter. • Physical: Toxic Revenger, Electrocutioner Leg, Glass Shooter, Thermaplugg's Left Arm. • Method doesn't list the **Manual Crowd Pummeler**, so its Forever status is unknown.

statements.title: Gnomeregan
statements.text: Rewards. • Data Rescue: Mechanic's Pipehammer or Repairman's Cape. • Gyrodrillmatic: Shilly Mitts or Shoni's Disarming Tool. • Grand Betrayal and Rig Wars: Civinad Robes, Dual Reinforced Leggings or Triprunner Dungarees. • A Fine Mess: Fairywing Mantle or Fire-welded Bracers. • Sparklematic: 2,450 XP per turn-in. • Classic level requirement 19, recommended 25–35.

statements.title: Razorfen Kraul
statements.text: Level range 29–38. A clear takes 20–30 minutes. 8 bosses. Southern Barrens, near the Great Lift.

statements.title: Razorfen Kraul
statements.text: Alliance take boats Stormwind → Auberdine → Menethil → Theramore, then run. Horde run south from Orgrimmar or Camp Taurajo.

statements.title: Razorfen Kraul
statements.text: Bosses: Roogug, Death Speaker Jargba, Aggem Thorncurse, Overlord Ramtusk, Agathelos, Blind Hunter (rare), Earthcaller Halmgar, Charlga Razorflank.

statements.title: Razorfen Kraul
statements.text: Alliance quests. • Mortality Wanes (level 25). • The Crone of the Kraul: starts from Lonebrow's Journal at the Great Lift. • Warrior quest: Fire Hardened Mail.

statements.title: Razorfen Kraul
statements.text: Horde and neutral quests. • Horde: Going, Going, Guano!, which unlocks Hearts of Zeal in Scarlet Monastery. • Horde: A Vengeful Fate. • Horde: An Unholy Alliance. It starts from Charlga's Small Scroll and continues in Razorfen Downs. • Horde Warrior quest: Brutal Armor. • Neutral: Blueleaf Tubers. • Neutral: Willix the Importer (escort).

statements.title: Razorfen Kraul
statements.text: Drops. Roogug had no loot in Classic. • Cloth: Death Speaker Mantle and Robes, Batwing Mantle. • Leather: Geomancer Headdress, Thorncursed Grips, Ferine Leggings, Whisperwind Headdress. • Mail: Tusken Helm, Quillord Mail Leggings. • Tank: Heart of Agamaggan. • Caster: Death Speaker Scepter, Death Prophet Spine, Wind Spirit Staff. • Physical: Corpsemaker, Thornspike, Swinetusk Shank, Nightstalker Bow, Pronged Reaver. • Trinket: Roogug's Severed Head.

statements.title: Razorfen Kraul
statements.text: Rewards. • Mortality Wanes: Mourning Shawl or Lancer Boots. • Crone of the Kraul: "Mage-Eye" Blunderbuss, plus a choice of Berylline Pads, Marbled Buckler or Stonefist Girdle. • Willix: Monkey Ring, Snake Hoop or Tiger Band. • Classic level requirement 25, recommended 30–40.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: Level range 30–38, Tirisfal Glades.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: The monastery is in north-east Tirisfal, east of Brill. No key needed. • Horde ride there from the Undercity. • Alliance fly to Southshore and cross the Alterac Mountains, or come from the east once they have the Chillwind Camp flight path.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: Bosses: Interrogator Vishas and Bloodmage Thalnos. Rares (each about 1 run in 3): Azshir the Sleepless, Fallen Champion, Ironspine.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: Drops. • Cloth: Blighted Leggings, Embalmed Shroud (healer), Bloodmage Mantle. • Leather: Ebon Vise, plus new rare leather helms. • Mail: Ironspine's Ribcage, Polished Skullcap (new). The 6-piece Chain of the Scarlet Crusade drops from Scarlet mobs in every wing. • Caster: Orb of the Forgotten Seer, Necrotic Wand. • Healer: Painwalker Buckler (new; about 0.6% from Vishas). • Physical: Morbid Dawn, Torturing Poker, Bloody Brass Knuckles, Ironspine's Fist.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: Horde quest Vorrel's Revenge. • Starts from Vorrel Sengutz inside the dungeon. • Turn in to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill, after killing Nancy Vishas in Alterac. • 3,300 XP. Grimsteel Cape or Mantle of Woe (cloth), plus Vorrel's Boots (leather).

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: Horde quest Hearts of Zeal: Master Apothecary Faranell. Needs Going, Going, Guano! (Razorfen Kraul) first. Collect 20 Hearts of Zeal in any wing.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: Total quest XP across all Scarlet Monastery wings: Alliance 3 quests, 20,350 XP. Horde 5 quests, 29,750 XP. There are also a Mage quest and a Rogue quest.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
statements.text: In Classic, Graveyard is 26–36 (tuned for 28–33). It is good until about level 32 and has the best solo AoE reset spots, with a very high XP return.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: Level range 33–41.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: Bosses: Houndmaster Loksey (with 3 elite hounds) and Arcanist Doan.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: Doan's Strongbox contains **The Scarlet Key**, which opens Armory and Cathedral. Each group member can loot one. Run Library first.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: Drops. • Leather: Dog Training Gloves. • Cloth: Mantle of Doan, Robe of Doan. • Caster: Hypnotic Blade, Illusionary Rod (45 spell power). • Physical: Loksey's Training Stick. • New in Forever: Houndmaster Boomerang, Spellsever Crossbow, Library Walkers (healer), Blueprint: Trapper's Workbench (very rare).

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: Alliance quests. • Mythology of the Titans: Librarian Mae Paledust, Ironforge. 8,900 XP. • Past Due: Magus Olvek, Dalaran. Loot a book from Doan. 6,750 XP. Appears to be new in Forever.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: Horde quests. • Compendium of the Fallen: Sage Truthseeker, Thunder Bluff. 8,450 XP. Not available to Undead characters. • Test of Lore: Parqual Fintallas, Undercity, at the end of a long chain that starts in Thousand Needles. 5,000 XP.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: Class quests: the Mage book Rituals of Power is in the Library, and the Rogue's Eye of Bhossca is here.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Library
statements.text: In Classic, Library is 29–39 and comes next after Graveyard until about level 35–36.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
statements.text: Level range 36–44. Needs the Scarlet Key. The only boss is Herod.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
statements.text: Herod's drops. Warriors still farm it. • Herod's Shoulder (mail). • Raging Berserker's Helm (leather). • Scarlet Leggings (mail). • Ravager (two-handed axe). In Forever it slows the wielder by 80% while its whirlwind proc runs.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
statements.text: No quest belongs only to the Armory. Herod counts toward the Cathedral kill quests.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
statements.text: Icy Veins headline: Forever turns Scarlet Monastery "junk loot" into real gear. The article itself was unreadable (403).

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
statements.text: In Classic, Armory is 32–42 and is the next wing from about level 35–36 to 39–40.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
statements.text: Level range 38–46. Needs the Scarlet Key. Bosses: High Inquisitor Fairbanks (optional), Scarlet Commander Mograine, High Inquisitor Whitemane.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
statements.text: Drops. • Fairbanks: Inquisitor's Shawl (cloth), Branded Leather Bracers, Dusty Mail Boots. • Mograine: Aegis of the Scarlet Commander (tank shield; in Forever it deals Holy damage when you block), Gauntlets of Divinity (mail healer), Mograine's Might. • Whitemane: Whitemane's Chapeau (cloth), Triune Amulet, Hand of Righteousness (healer).

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
statements.text: Alliance quest In the Name of the Light. Not shareable. • Chain: Brother Crowley (Stormwind) → Brother Anton (Desolace) → Raleigh the Devout (Southshore). • Kill Loksey, Herod, Mograine and Whitemane. 4,700 XP.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
statements.text: Horde quest Into the Scarlet Monastery: Varimathras. Shareable. The same four kills. 5,150 XP.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
statements.text: Let Whitemane resurrect Mograine before you kill him, or the kill won't count.

statements.title: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
statements.text: In Classic, Cathedral is 35–45. Run it from about 39–40 to 44–45. Mages AoE-farm it by pulling the whole wing.

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: Level range 37–46, at the southern edge of the Barrens near the Great Lift. No key.

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: Travel. • Horde fly to Camp Taurajo and ride south. • Alliance take the boat from Booty Bay to Ratchet, or from Menethil to Theramore, then ride. • Typical run levels: about 38 for Horde, 39+ for Alliance.

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: Bosses: Tuten'kash (gong event), Mordresh Fire Eye, Glutton, Ragglesnout (rare), Plaguemaw (optional), Amnennar the Coldbringer.

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: Drops. • Plate: Carapace of Tuten'kash. • Cloth: Robes of the Lich (caster), Deathmage Sash, Decaying Flesh Bands (new). • Leather: Bonefingers (now restores mana). • Mail: Deathchill Armor (caster), Boar Champion's Belt. • Caster and healer: Glowing Eye of Mordresh. • Tank: Icemetal Barbute. • Physical: Glutton's Cleaver, Coldrage Dagger, X'caliboar. • Recipe: Plans: Justicar's Boots.

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: Quests. Apart from updated rewards, they are the same as in Classic. • A Host of Evil: Myriam Moonsinger, outside the entrance. 8,200 XP. • Scourge of the Downs → Extinguishing the Idol: Belnistrasz escort. 4,250 XP, rewards Dragonclaw Ring. • Bring the Light (Alliance, Archbishop Benedictus) and Bring the End (Horde, Andrew Brownell): kill Amnennar. 4,300 XP. • An Unholy Alliance (Horde): 7,350 XP. Rewards were reduced from rare to uncommon on 8 Oct.

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: "Agamaggan's Blood" is no longer a dungeon quest. It can be completed in the elite area outside (17 Nov).

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: Quest XP totals: Alliance 17,430. Horde 24,780, or 30,680 including the Small Scroll step.

statements.title: Razorfen Downs
statements.text: In Classic, run it around level 42–43. It is harder and longer than SM and better for Horde.

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Level range 41–51, Badlands.

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Entrances and travel. No key. • The main entrance is at 43, 13. The back entrance, through Dustwind Gulch at 66, 43, leads to the second half. • Alliance fly to Thelsamar and ride south; they have no flight path in the Badlands. • Horde fly to Kargath.

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Bosses: Revelosh, the Lost Dwarves, Ironaya (needs the Staff of Prehistoria), Obsidian Sentinel, Ancient Stone Keeper, Galgann Firehammer, Grimlok, Archaedas.

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Drops. • Plate: Horned Viking Helmet, Cragfists (tank). • Mail: Rockshard Pauldrons (caster). • Leather: Oilskin Leggings. • Cloth: Stoneweaver Leggings (healer). • Caster: Galgann's Firehammer (now a caster mace with 54 spell power), Sandstorm Staff (new), White Obsidian Wand. • Healer: Battered Viking Shield (now a healer shield). • Tank: Dark Golem Breastplate, Axe of Lingering Dread. • The Obsidian Sentinel's loot is entirely new.

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Alliance quests. • The Shattered Necklace (each player now loots their own). • Uldaman Reagent Run (3,450 XP). • Reclaimed Treasures. • The Lost Tablets of Will (5,850 XP). • The Hidden Chamber (3,900 XP). • Agmond's Fate (5,000 XP).

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Horde quests. • Uldaman Reagent Run (Kargath, 3,450 XP). • Reclaimed Treasures (3,600 XP). • Necklace Recovery chain (5,600 XP for the final step).

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Quests for both factions. • Solution to Doom: 6,150 XP. Choice of Fists of Impending Doom, Doomcaller's Pants or Doomsayer's Robe. • Power Stones: 3,500 XP. • The Platinum Discs: 5,250 XP.

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: Quest XP totals: Alliance 55,730, Horde 35,950. Many Horde players go to Zul'Farrak instead.

statements.title: Uldaman
statements.text: In Classic, run it from about 42–43 to 46–47. It is the better option for Alliance.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: Level range 44–54, north-west Tanaris. No key. Most groups run it at 46–48.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: Both factions fly to Gadgetzan.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: Bosses. • Theka, Antu'sul, Zum'rah, Velratha. • Gahz'rilla: needs the **Mallet of Zul'Farrak**, made in the Hinterlands. • The stairs event: Sezz'ziz, Nekrum and the Executioner. • Sergeant Bly, Chief Ukorz Sandscalp. • Rares: Zerillis, Dustwraith, Sandarr Dunereaver.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: Drops. • Plate: Vice Grips, Big Bad Pauldrons. • Mail: Sandfury Pauldrons (new), Gahz'rilla Scale Armor. • Caster: Zum'rah's Vexing Cane, items from Sezz'ziz. • Physical: Gahz'rilla Fang, The Chief's Enforcer, Ripsaw, Embrace of the Lycan. • Trinket: Theka's Last Breath (new). • Sul'thraze the Lasher: combine Jang'thraze and Sang'thraze (about 1% each). • Sandarr: new mail and plate healer items.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: Quests for both factions. • Divino-matic Rod: 6,300 XP. • Gahz'rilla: 7,100 XP, rewards Carrot on a Stick. • Tiara of the Deep: 6,050 XP. • The Prophecy of Mosh'aru: 5,250 XP. Continues into the Sunken Temple. • Troll Temper: 3,900 XP. • Scarab Shells: 3,900 XP.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: Faction quests. • Alliance: Nekrum's Medallion (Nethergarde Keep), 5,250 XP. Total 37,750. • Horde: The Spider God (Sen'jin), 4,850 XP. Total 37,350. • Mage class quest: A Lesson in Literacy.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: A rogue quest, "The Talisman of Kazdor", sent players into the wrong version of Zul'Farrak (fixed 13 Nov). Zum'rah's spawn for it was fixed on 16 Nov.

statements.title: Zul'Farrak
statements.text: In Classic, Zul'Farrak is one of the best XP grinds; mages and hunters farm the graveyard zombies. It is also a mage gold farm.

statements.title: Maraudon (whole dungeon)
statements.text: Level range 46–55, listed as a single dungeon. No Forever source gives separate ranges for the wings. Desolace.

statements.title: Maraudon (whole dungeon)
statements.text: Entrance and travel. • The entrance is in the Valley of Spears, around 29, 62. • Horde fly to Shadowprey Village and ride about 1 minute north. • Alliance fly to Nijel's Point and ride south.

statements.title: Maraudon (whole dungeon)
statements.text: 6 Nov hotfix: Zaetar's Spirit now appears after Princess Theradras.

statements.title: Maraudon (whole dungeon)
statements.text: Quests. Each faction gets 40,700 XP from 8 quests. • Corruption of Earth and Seed: 6,100 XP. Thrash Blade, Resurgence Rod or Verdant Keeper's Aim. • Legends of Maraudon: 3,400 XP. • The Scepter of Celebras: 5,700 XP. • Seed of Life: 6,100 XP. • The Pariah's Instructions: 5,450 XP. • Twisted Evils: 5,250 XP. • Vyletongue Corruption: 5,250 XP. • Shadowshard Fragments: 3,450 XP.

statements.title: Maraudon (whole dungeon)
statements.text: Do the outdoor quest steps before entering. Finish the Scepter chain on your first run.

statements.title: Maraudon (whole dungeon)
statements.text: Rare Meshlok: Nature's Embrace (Holy caster robe), Fungus Shroud Armor (leather), Bloomsprout Headpiece.

statements.title: Maraudon (whole dungeon)
statements.text: In Classic, Maraudon is 45–52. The Scepter of Celebras opened the portal to Earth Song Falls; after patch 3.0.8 it was no longer required. Do a few runs before level 50.

statements.title: Maraudon: Wicked Grotto (Purple)
statements.text: Follow the purple path. The Shadowshard elementals are near the portal.

statements.title: Maraudon: Wicked Grotto (Purple)
statements.text: Drops. • Gizlock: Inventor's Focal Sword (caster, 60 spell power), Megashot Rifle, Gizlock's Hypertech Buckler. • Vyletongue: Celebrian Diamond (quest), Satyrmane Sash (caster), Infernal Trickster Leggings, Satyr's Lash.

statements.title: Maraudon: Wicked Grotto (Purple)
statements.text: Bosses: Gizlock, Vyletongue, Celebras the Cursed, Meshlok (rare).

statements.title: Maraudon: Foulspore Cavern (Orange)
statements.text: Drops. • Noxxion: Celebrian Rod (quest), Noxxion's Shackles, Heart of Noxxion (anti-poison trinket), Noxious Shooter (wand). • Razorlash: Vinerot Sandals (caster), Phytoskin Spaulders (leather).

statements.title: Maraudon: Foulspore Cavern (Orange)
statements.text: Vyletongue Corruption: fill the vial at the orange pool outside, then heal 8 vines.

statements.title: Maraudon: Foulspore Cavern (Orange)
statements.text: Bosses: Razorlash, Noxxion.

statements.title: Maraudon: Earth Song Falls (Inner)
statements.text: Reach it by dropping through Poison Falls, or through the Scepter portal. Bosses: Celebras, Landslide, Princess Theradras, Rotgrip.

statements.title: Maraudon: Earth Song Falls (Inner)
statements.text: Drops. • Celebras: Soothsayer's Headdress, Grovekeeper's Drape, Claw of Celebras. • Landslide: Fist of Stone, Helm of the Mountain, Rockgrip Gauntlets. • Theradras: Princess Theradras' Scepter, Blackstone Ring, Bracers of the Stone Princess, Eye of Theradras, Elemental Rockridge Leggings, Gemshard Heart, Blade of Eternal Darkness (about 0.26%). • Rotgrip: Gatorbite Axe, Rotgrip Mantle, Albino Crocscale Boots.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: Level range 50–60, Swamp of Sorrows. No key. Most groups run it at 50–54.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: The entrance is at the Pool of Tears, around 69, 53. Horde fly to Stonard. Alliance fly to Nethergarde Keep.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: Group size is 5. In Classic it was 10 from patch 1.3.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: 16 Nov hotfix: the serpent statues no longer get stuck when activated in the wrong order.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: Statue order: S, N, SW, SE, NW, NE. Kill the 6 troll guardians before Jammal'an.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: Drops. Only about a quarter of these have confirmed Forever stats. • Mail: Atal'ai Breastplate, Horns of Eranikus. • Cloth: Atal'ai Gloves (caster), Vestments and Kilt of the Atal'ai Prophet. • Caster: Nightfall Drape, Rod of Corrosion, Spire of Hakkar. • Physical: Smoldering Claw, Fist of the Damned, Headspike. • Tank: Drakeclaw Band, Slitherscale Boots (now with defense). • Epic: Dragon's Call (about 0.19%).

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: Quests for both factions. • The God Hakkar: needs the Mosh'aru chain from Zul'Farrak. 7,900 XP. Avenguard Helm (plate), Lifeforce Dirk or Gemburst Circlet (cloth). • Jammal'an the Prophet: 6,550 XP. Rainstrider Leggings (cloth) or Helm of Exile (mail). • Secret of the Circle: 6,100 XP. • Into the Depths: 4,900 XP. • The Essence of Eranikus: 2,800 XP. Not shareable.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: Faction quests. • Alliance: Into the Temple of Atal'Hakkar (7,100 XP), Haze of Evil (5,100 XP). Total 40,450. • Horde: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar (5,900 XP), Zapper Fuel (5,100 XP). Total 39,250.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: Every class has a level-52 class quest here, available from 50. Each gives 12,400 XP and a choice of 3 rare class items. • Warrior, Paladin, Shaman, Warlock: voodoo feathers from the troll guardians. • Hunter, Mage, Priest, Rogue: an item from Morphaz. • Druid: the Putrid Vine from Atal'alarion.

statements.title: Sunken Temple (Temple of Atal'Hakkar)
statements.text: In Classic, run it until at least 52. It has fewer, tougher mobs than Zul'Farrak.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Level range 52–60. Most quests open from 48–52. Enter from 54+.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: At the bottom of Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes. No key needed to enter.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Flight paths. • Both factions: Thorium Point. • Alliance: Morgan's Vigil. • Horde: Kargath and Flame Crest. • You walk into the mountain from Searing Gorge (around 34, 74) or from Burning Steppes.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: The Shadowforge Key comes from Dark Iron Legacy (Franclorn's ghost). Lockpicking 250 also opens the gates.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Get the Shadowforge Key on your first run. Most groups split Blackrock Depths into 2–3 runs. • Run 1: Detention Block, Ring of Law, Vault, Fineous, Incendius, Bael'Gar. • Run 2: Angerforge, Argelmach, Grim Guzzler, Emperor.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Bosses. • Detention Block: Gerstahn, Roccor, Grebmar. • Ring of Law: one boss from a pool of 6, or Theldren. • Loregrain, Bael'Gar, Incendius, Fineous, Stilgiss/Verek, Doomgrip, Angerforge, Argelmach. • Grim Guzzler: Hurley, Phalanx, Ribbly, Plugger. • Flamelash, Panzor (rare), The Seven, Magmus, Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: 9 Nov hotfix: the throne doors now open after a wipe on the Emperor. The Heart of the Mountain can be looted more than once.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: About 35 quests (21 Alliance, 23 Horde, 9 shared). Quest XP: about 200,400 Alliance, about 212,000 Horde.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Princess quest rings. • Alliance: Magni's Will (Strength/crit) or Songstone of Ironforge (caster). • Horde: Thrall's Resolve or Eye of Orgrimmar (caster).

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Quest givers. • Horde: Kargath. • Alliance: Ironforge. • Both factions: Burning Steppes (Pyron, Incendius, Heart of the Mountain). • Also Attunement to the Core.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: New Forever quest Fragment of the Firelands. The fragment drops from Magmus about 1 kill in 4. Attunement to the Core is unavailable.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Onyxia attunement (Alliance): the Blackrock Depths steps are A Crumpled Up Note, A Shred of Hope and Jail Break!

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Drops. • Physical: Hand of Justice (Emperor, 16%), Ironfoe (<1%), Lord General's Sword, Ragefury Eyepatch, Naglering. • Mail: Savage Gladiator Chain (the set now has 6 pieces). • Tank: Stoneshell Guard, Warstrife Leggings, Golem Skull Helm. • Caster: Kindling Stave (now 60 spell power), Greaves of Withering Despair, Omnicast Boots, Burst of Knowledge. • Healer: Senior Designer's Pantaloons, Hammer of Grace. • Hunter: Houndmaster's Bow.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: A full clear takes 4–6 hours on average.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Repeat value: Emperor farming, arena runs, lava runs.

statements.title: Blackrock Depths
statements.text: Zockify says Blackrock Depths is capped at 5 players.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Level range 55–60.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Beta datamine: the Group Finder listed Lower and Upper Blackrock Spire at level 53. The Spire was flagged 10-player, changed in Forever. No lockout.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Route. No key needed for Lower Blackrock Spire. • The mountain gate is around 29, 37 in Burning Steppes. The Searing Gorge path starts around 34, 74. • Inside the mountain, go left to the chain statue, then the balcony door.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Bosses. • Omokk, Vosh'gajin, Voone, Mother Smolderweb. • Urok Doomhowl: summoned with Omokk's head on the pike. • Zigris, Halycon, Gizrul, Wyrmthalak. • Rares: Bannok Grimaxe, Crystal Fang, Spirestone Battle Lord, Spirestone Lord Magus.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: 27 quests. Quest XP: about 167,350 Alliance and 159,100 Horde. Without the quests that need Upper Blackrock Spire: 116,000 Alliance, 102,800 Horde.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Notable quests. • Seal of Ascension (Vaelan): rewards the Upper Blackrock Spire key. 8,300 + 9,950 XP. • Mother's Milk: Ragged John's Neverending Cup. • Urok Doomhowl: Prismcharm. • Kibler's pet quests: the pets are no longer bind-on-pickup. • Maxwell's Mission (Alliance) and Warlord's Command (Horde): each offers a choice of 5 rares.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Seal of Ascension. Expect 2–3 runs to get all three gems. • Spirestone gem: Omokk, 27%. • Smolderthorn gem: Voone, 35%. • Bloodaxe gem: Wyrmthalak, 41%. • Then defeat Emberstrife in Dustwallow Marsh and forge the seal.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Horde Onyxia attunement: Warlord's Command is done in Lower Blackrock Spire.

statements.title: Lower Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Drops. • Mail: Boots of Elements (Omokk; now 14 spell power), Beaststalker's Gloves (Voone), Beaststalker's Mantle (Wyrmthalak), Trueaim Gauntlets. • Leather: Shadowcraft Gloves (Vosh'gajin), Wildheart Boots (Smolderweb), Wildheart Spaulders (Gizrul; now 20 healing). • Physical: Fist of Omokk, Halycon's Spiked Collar, Slashclaw Bracers, Heart of Wyrmthalak, Mark of the Dragon Lord. • Recipes: Plans: Arcanite Reaper (Bannok), Pattern: Robe of the Archmage.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Level range 59–60, quests from 55–58. CC calls it a dungeon. It was 10-player in Classic, and no different cap has been announced for Forever.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: In Classic it is a 10-player raid instance (15 before patch 1.10), levels 56–61. The wiki says the original instance stays in Classic and Forever.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Blizzard's raid list doesn't include it. It appears only as a quest location.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: One group member needs the Seal of Ascension.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Bosses. • Pyroguard Emberseer, Solakar Flamewreath. • Jed Runewatcher (rare). • Goraluk Anvilcrack. • Rend Blackhand and Gyth. • The Beast, General Drakkisath. • Lord Valthalak: summoned.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: 24 quests. Quest XP: about 146,050 Alliance and 147,750 Horde. Some quest XP is slightly lower than in Classic.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Drops. • Drakkisath: all nine Dungeon Set 1 chests. • Emberseer: Gauntlets of Elements (mail), Flaming Band, Wildfire Cape. • Solakar: Devout Mantle (cloth), Nightbrace Tunic. • Rend: Spaulders of Valor (plate), Warmaster Legguards, Dal'Rend's pair of weapons, Felstriker. • Gyth: Pauldrons of Elements (mail), Chromatic Carapace. • The Beast: Lightforge Spaulders (plate), Tristam Legguards, Blademaster Leggings, Seeping Willow. • Goraluk: Plans for Arcanite Champion and Masterwork Stormhammer.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Plans: Demon Forged Breastplate now needs 260 Blacksmithing.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: Upper Blackrock Spire is the final step of **both** Onyxia attunements: the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from Drakkisath.

statements.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
statements.text: 17 Nov hotfix: Upper Blackrock Spire creatures restored to their intended health and damage, which makes it harder.

statements.title: Dire Maul East (Warpwood Quarter)
statements.text: Level range 54–60. Enter from the east side of the ruins in Feralas. No key needed.

statements.title: Dire Maul East (Warpwood Quarter)
statements.text: Pusillin drops the **Crescent Key** after a chase. It is permanent and opens West and North. One keyholder can open the doors for the whole group.

statements.title: Dire Maul East (Warpwood Quarter)
statements.text: Feralas flight paths: Feathermoon Stronghold (Alliance) and Camp Mojache (Horde).

statements.title: Dire Maul East (Warpwood Quarter)
statements.text: Bosses: Pusillin, Zevrim Thornhoof, Hydrospawn, Lethtendris, Old Ironbark, Alzzin the Wildshaper. Isalien is summoned for the Dungeon Set 2 chain.

statements.title: Dire Maul East (Warpwood Quarter)
statements.text: Quests. • Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin: 20,750 XP. New Forever rewards: boots, sword or pants. • Lethtendris's Web: 20,200 XP, rewards Lorespinner. • Shards of the Felvine: Milli's Shield or Milli's Lexicon. • Arcane Refreshment: Mage quest.

statements.title: Dire Maul East (Warpwood Quarter)
statements.text: Drops. • Zevrim: Helm of Awareness, Satyr's Bow. • Hydrospawn: Tempest Talisman, Waterspout Boots, Waveslicer. • Lethtendris: Felhide Cap, Quel'dorai Channeling Rod. • Alzzin: Energized Chestplate, Energetic Rod, Fiendish Machete.

statements.title: Dire Maul East (Warpwood Quarter)

statements.title: Dire Maul West (Capital Gardens)
statements.text: Bosses: Tendris Warpwood, Illyanna Ravenoak, Magister Kalendris, Tsu'zee (rare), Immol'thar (after the 5 pylons), Prince Tortheldrin, Lord Hel'nurath (optional).

statements.title: Dire Maul West (Capital Gardens)
statements.text: Quests. • The Madness Within → The Treasure of the Shen'dralar. • Elven Legends. • **New:** The Broken Glaive → The Darkened Glaive. • Fragments of the Past (Alliance). • Falrin's Vendetta. • The Instigator's Enchantment.

statements.title: Dire Maul West (Capital Gardens)
statements.text: Drops. • Physical: Force Imbued Gauntlets, Mind Carver. • Caster and healer: Padre's Trousers, Mindtap Talisman, Elder Magus Pendant. • Brightspark Gloves, Vigilance Charm (tank). • Recipe: Pattern: Big Bag of Enchantment (now needs 255 Tailoring).

statements.title: Dire Maul West (Capital Gardens)
statements.text: Class book quests give a trinket. Librams drop in every wing.

statements.title: Dire Maul North (Gordok Commons)

statements.text: Stratholme quest XP across both sides: about 109,350 Alliance and 115,950 Horde.
Deviate Hides and Smart Drinks in Wailing Caverns are deliberately designed so one clear usually does not drop enough quest items for the whole party.
Dungeon quest item drops now use a round-robin style distribution among party members.
In City of Dalaran, the Alliance quest Starving Arcane lacks enough quest mobs to finish in one run. The Horde quest Source of Power has the same problem.
Blackfathom Deeps Alliance quests Researching the Corruption and Twilight Falls usually cannot be finished in a single run.
Linken's Boots of Iron can drop from any boss in The Drowned City. They reportedly let the wearer walk on the bottom of water but move slowly on land.
Most Krol'dok Stronghold quests unlock only after the Riverglades main story. The Krol'dok Moulding chain leads to a key that opens a shortcut inside the dungeon.
The Alcaz Operative Insignia disguise toy comes from combining six Fractured Insignia. The chain starts with The Man in the Iron Chains in Alcaz Prison and continues via Moonbrook.
Wearing all 5 Krol'dok Battlegear pieces (a tank plate set) turns the player into an ogre once the set bonus reaches max stacks.
Krol'dok Stronghold has 5 Alliance quests and 4 Horde quests.
Nar'gurk mind-converts a random player, and the party must bring that player to 50% health to break it.
Twilight Grunts are the most dangerous Krol'dok trash: their Bladestorm hits everyone within 8 yards, and multiple Grunts stack quickly.
Twilight Commander Zarmok uses AoE Rending Whirl and enrages at 30% health.
Overlord Mugg switches from maces to mauls and leaps at random players with Crushing Slam, knocking back nearby players.
Dungeon mob kill XP in Forever is reduced to about 60% of the original Classic values.
Known issue: in Razorfen Kraul, a cauldron near Roogug can trap players who fall into it, so avoid that spot until it is fixed.
In Shaper's Terrace, Vitrix's Poison Shock deals less damage since 19 Nov.
In City of Dalaran, the Shade of the Archmage no longer despawns as soon as combat starts (fixed 19 Nov), so the encounter can be fought.
A player can reset and re-enter the same dungeon five times in an hour.
Repeat runs of one dungeon are limited to five resets and re-entries an hour.
The hourly allowance applies to each dungeon individually.
Captain Dreadrise’s Abyssal Bubble in The Drowned City can no longer block, dodge or parry.
A full run of The Drowned City takes at least an hour on average.
Wowhead's 'at level' suggestions: Gnomeregan 33, City of Dalaran 31, Razorfen Kraul 31, Scarlet Monastery 37, Razorfen Downs 39, The Drowned City 40.
Razorfen Downs has a new level-34 quest, The Coldbringer's Eye. Horde get it from Sutara Plainstalker on Skywatcher Plateau, Alliance from Archbishop Benedictus.

City of Dalaran quests: • The Grave Knight (Melisara, Tarren Mill) • Source of Power (Doctor Martin Felben, Undercity) • Opportunistic Education (Rexxie Copperclutch, at the entrance inside) • Power Overwhelming (High Sorcerer Andromath, Stormwind) • A Green Sample (Shylamiir, Stormwind) • Starving Arcane (Alliance, after An Alarming Request)
In Razorfen Downs, every party member must finish Scourge of the Downs before anyone starts the Extinguishing the Idol escort, or those who haven't get no credit.
Loremaster Dibbs' Drowned City quests in Southshore open after a chain that starts with The Second Rebellion / Bad Medicine and ends with Troll Witchery.
Alcaz Prison is a short dungeon, about 30 minutes per run.

Alcaz Prison secret quest The Man in the Iron Chains: • Mason Connery offers it after the last boss, only if The Questioner was skipped. • You then kill The Questioner to complete it. • Reward: 25 gold.
Sergeant Ulka on Alcaz Island also gives Horde A Little Payback and Blood Red Bandanas (level 48), after Eitrigg's The Missing Kor'kron chain.
19 Nov dungeon fixes: City of Dalaran's Shade of the Archmage no longer despawns when pulled, and Vitrix's Poison Shock in The Shaper's Terrace deals less damage.
The hourly reset limit for repeat entries to one dungeon fell from ten to five.
Uldaman's Obsidian Sentinel no longer drops its blue items (undocumented change, about 22 Nov). It now gives only junk such as Solid Stone.

Group finder level ranges for the new dungeons: Hall of Thanes 13–20, Ruins of Lordaeron 15–22, Excavation Site: Wetlands 26–33, City of Dalaran 28–35, Drowned City 35–42, Krol'dok Stronghold 40–47, Alcaz Prison 48–55, Blackmaw Hold 55–60, Shaper's Terrace 58–60.

Group finder level ranges for the levelling Classic dungeons: RFC 13–18, WC 15–24, Deadmines 17–26, SFK 20–30, BFD and Stockade 24–32, RFK and Gnomeregan 29–38, SM Graveyard 30–38, Library 33–41, Armory 36–44, RFD 37–46, Cathedral 38–46, Uldaman 41–51, ZF 44–54, Maraudon 46–55.

Common raid-marker convention: Skull kill first, X second; Circle for Sap, Diamond for warlock CC, Moon for Polymorph, Square for Frost Trap, Star for Shackle, Triangle for Hibernate. Confirm with your group.
Shaper's Terrace's entrance is on a hill above Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro, at about 48.1, 6.1.
In Shaper's Terrace the Green Archival Panel summons Vitrix.
Power crystals for Shaper's Terrace can also be gathered inside the dungeon, at the cost of more trash fights; all 15 of a colour must be in your bags before the console can be used.
Mounts can be used inside Shaper's Terrace; a clockwise loop covers every panel and boss.
Vitrix in Shaper's Terrace can wipe a whole party early on; feeding the Green panel without killing it is enough to progress, so skipping it is advised.
Titanosaur, a patrolling devilsaur in Shaper's Terrace, fears the party periodically; clear nearby packs first, and a Tremor Totem makes the fight easy.
Venomridge in Shaper's Terrace poisons the whole party repeatedly; a Poison Cleansing Totem or dispels handle it. Alliance need it for Panic at the Digsite.
Tor'Rel (fire) and Izha'Rel (ice, with Frost Armor) in Shaper's Terrace: kill Tor'Rel first; both call Ravasaur Stalker adds when low.
Snowtalon in Shaper's Terrace uses Frost Nova and Cone of Cold; pull it out of its cave and keep it facing away from the group.
Direhorn Matriarch in Shaper's Terrace has a tail-swipe AoE behind her and charges random players; stand grouped at her sides.
Thunderhoof in Shaper's Terrace casts lightning spells that should be interrupted; otherwise nature resistance helps.
Bolt in Shaper's Terrace casts instant Chain Lightning on random players; ranged and healers should spread out and heal through it.
Cinder in Shaper's Terrace is simple once nearby fire elementals are cleared; fire resistance such as a paladin aura helps.
Nanaya, Shaper's Terrace's final boss, draws on crystal formations to change damage type and abilities (blue gives Blizzard, yellow Chain Lightning) and AoE-stuns nearby players; the fight is easy.
Falling off the narrow ledge by the small lake in Shaper's Terrace ejects you from the dungeon.
Horde's The Dark Crystal uses the Achromatic Crystal in Shaper's Terrace's tar pits, where Seeping Slimes drop the essence for Essence of Seeping Slimes.
Warcraft Tavern's guide gives Alcaz Island Prison a level range of 48–55, wider than the official 48–53.
Alcaz trash: Strashaz Soldiers charge players at range, so healers should watch more than the tank and DPS can stand inside the minimum charge distance.
Alcaz trash: Strashaz Enchantresses cast Polymorph, so interrupt them, especially in big packs.
Alcaz trash: Slavering Hounds stack diseases on their target, so bring someone who can remove diseases.
Tidemistress Ca'zass fights alongside two Strashaz Enchantresses. All three cast Frostbolt Volley and Polymorph, and she also places a Blizzard to step out of. Kill the adds first and interrupt.
Overseer Wrex pulls every mob in his section when engaged. Wait for his patrol to move away, clear the side cells, then pull him clear of the remaining mobs.
Katerina the Cleaner has two Alcaz Chaplain priests; kill them first. She teleports behind random players to backstab, but her damage is low.
Zarla Ober starts as a fire caster using Fireball and Flamestrike. At low health she turns into Blazeroar, and the tank must face the dragon away from the group to avoid its fire breath.
Blazeroar casts an area fear, so a shaman's Tremor Totem is valuable for this fight.
The Questioner starts the fight with adds; kill them first. Interrupt his Drain Life.
Horde in Alcaz: The Honor of the Kor'kron comes from Commander Folkar, chained behind Katerina. Bad News for Folkar starts from a perfumed note after Blazeroar dies.

Horde in Alcaz: A Little Payback and Blood Red Bandanas also come from Sergeant Ulka on Alcaz Island (about 70.3, 19.0). The first needs Strashaz naga and Ca'zass's Head; the second needs Defias kills.
The Dragon's Journal (Alliance) has no prerequisite. It comes from Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran at about 15.5, 73.4 and needs Zarla's Journal from Zarla Ober.
More Valuable Than Gold, the last quest of Mason Connery's chain in Alcaz, sends players to look for treasure in Westfall.
Blackmaw Hold is bigger than Blackrock Depths, which used to be the largest dungeon, and has no fixed path.
The Blackmaw Hold portal lies deep in the tunnel, on the Winterspring map at about 66.6, 84.4. Mounts can be used in the Blackmaw Grove area at the start.
Blackmaw Hold shortcut: jump off the ledge straight ahead of the hold's entrance with Slow Fall or the Skyborne Walk on Air racial. You land at Blackmaw Behemoth and skip most of the dungeon.
Blackmaw Hold trash: Bloated Grizzlies explode at low health for AoE damage and a disease. Legashi Plaguebringers summon a rat swarm with an uninterruptible cast, so kill them fast or hard CC them.
Withermaw keeps spawning Flesh Maggots that the tank must pick up. It also casts Fear and applies diseases, so bring ways to remove them.
Bonesnout the Unbroken: each of the 4 Legashi Ritualists gives the boss 25% damage resistance. A confident group can pull it before all four are dead. Its Stomp stuns everyone nearby.
Impaan the Imprisoner sits on the Defiled Peak, up a winding path in Blackmaw Grove, and periodically summons several imp adds.
Unbound Spirit: talk to Elder Bramblesnap to start. He purifies the 3 Profane Totems so they can be destroyed while spirit beast adds spawn. Once the totems fall, the boss loses its shield.
Elder Shaman Bloodmane: kill the Blackmaw Devotees around him first. He summons two Feral Spirits, casts an interruptible Chain Lightning and an uninterruptible Purge.

Blackmaw Behemoth and Clawbert: focus Clawbert first, because his uninterruptible Restore heals the Behemoth to full. Interrupt the Behemoth's Bestial Roar (damage reduction) and, after he eats Clawbert, his stunning Thunder Roar.
Varrox Bleakhoof's Crimson Wrest drags a random player to the boss, where they take heavy damage and explode on allies, leaving a damaging void zone. The tank should move the boss to limit it.
A sparkling hole behind Blackmaw Behemoth drops straight to Varrox Bleakhoof. Afterwards, an air stream in the pool carries the group back up to the Behemoth area.
In Blackmaw Hold, a Flesh-Eating Lasher trades looted Fel-Tainted Flesh for Regurgitated Seed Pods. These usually give high-level herbs and rarely the Wilted Lashling pet.
Blackmaw Hold contains 7 bosses and 3 rare spawns that appear only sometimes (Moontouched Wanderer, Gortek the Apprentice, Tunnelweb Matriarch).
Warcraft Tavern gives Krol'dok Stronghold a level range of 40–47, wider at the top than the official 40–45.
Krol'dok Stronghold's entrance is a cave just west of the big fortress gates, at about 37.5, 37.5 in north Riverglades above Sunnyglade.
Mounts can be used inside Krol'dok Stronghold. On a first run no shortcuts are open, so the main cobbled road leads through the whole dungeon.

Krol'dok trash threats: Twilight Grunts spin a Bladestorm-like AoE (melee should back off), Outriders root and spread to cast, Lieutenants disarm, Peons flee and pull more mobs (slow them), Centurions apply Mortal Strike.
Slavecrusher Grox patrols the quarry: clear the area while he is away, then pull him. He calls in Redridge Prisoner adds and sometimes stuns the tank.
Twilight Commander Zarmok also patrols: clear a space first (the left wall works) and expect charges on random players. Killing him opens the gate onward.
War Handler Ashka sends her two wolves at random players with Command: Kill!. Kill the wolves before her.

Nar'gurk fights with warlock and curseweaver adds that stack magic DoTs, so CC or kill them first. He also does AoE damage and mind-controls players with Convert: CC or damage the charmed player to break it.

Bossman Toof is a gauntlet across two bridges that starts when you engage the first Centurions. He sends pairs of Brutes, so push forward fast and save mana. At the end he is a tougher Centurion backed by two Krol'dok Shamans.

Overlord Mugg comes with two Centurions; handle them first. Spread out, because he leaps onto random players with AoE on landing. He moves to stronger weapons as his health drops, so kill him quickly.

Krol'dok Stronghold has 4 Horde and 5 Alliance quests. Horde unlock them through Clugfist's Decree, then the chain starting with The Wayward Warrior. Alliance first need Curious Trinkets, Saving Sunnyglade and Scraps of Knowledge at Farholde Keep.
The Alliance Vengeance of the Highborne target, Zalfan Moonshadow, is a warlock among the Twilight Warlocks up the left fork before Nar'gurk.

City of Dalaran has four dungeon quests per faction. Horde: Source of Power, The Grave Knight, Opportunistic Education and Heart of Disruption. Alliance: Power Overwhelming, A Green Sample, Starving Arcane and Heart of Disruption.

Horde Dalaran attunement, Prison Break In: collect four Bloodstone pieces from four named neutral mobs in the Lordamere Internment Camp. The pieces always drop, but the mobs respawn slowly. Key to the City's Grimy Key is in a Warden's Footlocker guarded by Warden Belamoore.
Stone Tokens (Keeper Bel'varil, Tarren Mill) is not part of the Horde Dalaran attunement. It asks for 10 Worn Stone Tokens from rare, slow-respawning camp guards with a low drop rate.
Dalaran Shield Guards near the Lordamere Internment Camp use Violent Shield, which reflects melee damage back at the attacker. It is poorly telegraphed, so melee should watch for it.
Dalaran Patrols, Horde attunement step 2: kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 8 Elemental Slaves in the Old Dalaran Ruins. Elemental Slaves are immune to bleeds.
Blood in the Streets is completed just by speaking to the Image of Archmage Modera at the Dalaran sewer entrance.

Horde hand in Heart of Disruption to Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill. The follow-up, Shrewd Negotiations, returns the Arcane Mote to Modera's image. It does not give Horde access to Dalaran city; the beta version did.
City of Dalaran's final boss is the Shade of the Archmage. You reach him by talking to Archmage Modera on the Violet Citadel steps, who opens a portal to the Violet Chamber.
Alliance hand Heart of Disruption in to Modera's image. Its follow-up, Friend of the Kirin Tor, sends you into Dalaran city to give the Arcane Mote to Archmage Celindra in the Violet Citadel.

Horde quest givers for City of Dalaran: Source of Power from Doctor Martin Felben (Undercity Apothecarium), 6 Cracked Sentry Cores from Fragmented Sentry golems. The Grave Knight from Melisara (Tarren Mill), kill the first boss Atrexis.

Opportunistic Education starts inside City of Dalaran, from Rexxie Copperclutch on the right of the entrance. Loot The Founding of Dalaran tome at the far end of the Atrium of Fortune, past the Angry Tome mobs.

Alliance quest givers for City of Dalaran: Power Overwhelming from High Sorcerer Andromath (Stormwind Wizard's Sanctum), kill the Arcanic Enigma boss. A Green Sample from Shylamiir (Stormwind), take a Fel Infused Blossom from Runeweaver Square.
Runeweaver Square in City of Dalaran is shielded. Talk to Magus Fansy Goodbringer on its east side to drop the shield and fight the Fel Ancient boss.
Horde quest Into The Scarlet Monastery: from Varimathras in the Undercity Royal Quarter, shareable, needs level 33. Kill Loksey (Library), Herod (Armory), and Mograine and Whitemane (Cathedral).
In the Test of Lore chain, answer Braug Dimspirit with Neltharion. A wrong answer teleports you to the Barrens.
Scarlet Monastery quest level requirements: Vorrel's Revenge and Test of Lore 25, Mythology of the Titans and Compendium of the Fallen 28, Past Due and Hearts of Zeal 30, In the Name of the Light 34.
Scarlet Monastery quests are mostly unchanged from Classic. The differences are updated loot and rewards.
Gnomeregan's quests in Forever are the Classic ones; only their rewards were changed.

Gnomeregan quest level requirements: Save Techbot's Brain!, Gnogaine, The Only Cure is More Green Glow, Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators and A Fine Mess need 20; Essential Artificials needs 24; Data Rescue, The Grand Betrayal, Grime-Encrusted Ring and the Horde chain need 25.
Kernobee (A Fine Mess) does not draw or fight mobs, so a stealthed escort works. If he dies he does not respawn, and the dungeon must be run again.
Essential Artificials needs 12 items. Each Artificial Extrapolator vanishes once used, so a party sharing the quest may have to clear the whole instance.
Gnogaine is done outside Gnomeregan on irradiated troggs. Finish it before the run so the follow-up, The Only Cure is More Green Glow, is in your log inside.
Blackrock Depths is listed for levels 52–60 with 27 possible bosses, one of them a rare spawn; the guide is still based on Classic since the dungeon was not in the beta.
In Blackrock Depths the Shadowforge gates need the Shadowforge Key from the Dark Iron Legacy quest, or Lockpicking 250.
High Interrogator Gerstahn in Blackrock Depths drops the Prison Cell Key, which opens the cells of the quest prisoners, including Marshal Windsor.
In the Black Vault of Blackrock Depths, opening all 12 Relic Coffer doors spawns Watchman Doomgrip and opens a safe holding the Heart of the Mountain quest item.
The Black Forge on the Molten Bridge in Blackrock Depths is the only place miners can smelt Dark Iron bars, so groups do lava runs straight to it.
Groups farm Blackrock Depths' Ring of Law on its own (arena runs) and reset the dungeon until the random boss with the wanted drop appears.
Krol'dok Stronghold is a five-player Riverglades dungeon aimed at about levels 40 to 45, with six main bosses and long trash stretches.
Krol'dok Twilight Outriders patrol in threes, use Multi-Shot and root the tank for 10 seconds with Hooked Net; pull them around a corner. Blessing of Freedom clears the root.
Krol'dok Twilight Peons flee for help; slow or stun them at once, for example with Hamstring or Hammer of Justice.
Krol'dok Shamans cast Lightning Bolt and Bloodlust and should be killed first, including the two beside Bossman Toof.
Slavecrusher Grox gains 30% attack speed for 30 seconds from Bloodlust, stuns the tank for 2 seconds with Knockdown, and calls non-elite prisoners that should be killed quickly.
Twilight Commander Zarmok's Rending Whirl hits everyone within 8 yards and leaves a 15-second bleed; ranged and healers should stay beyond 8 yards.
War Handler Ashka's Command: Kill! sends her two pets, Snarlfang and Terrorhowl, onto a random player for 10 seconds; kill the pets before the boss.
Nar'gurk's Convert mind-controls a player for up to 20 seconds and breaks when that player drops to 50% health; crowd-control his three adds before the pull.
Bossman Toof's fight starts on a bridge where pairs of Krol'dok Brutes keep arriving. Clear a wave before pulling the boss. His Mortal Strike cuts healing taken by 50% for 5 seconds.
Overlord Mugg's maces raise his melee damage by 20% and his mauls by 50% in the last phase. Deal with his two centurions before damaging him.
The Alliance Krol'dok quest Tome of Twilight from Ashe Amberhall requires the quest A Small Favor first.
Alliance Krol'dok Stronghold quests give Brotherhood of the Horse reputation, 100 to 150 each. Vengeance of the Highborne also gives 250 Kirin Tor.
Slavecrusher Grox in Krol'dok Stronghold can drop the recipe Blueprint: Expert Campfire Cooking.
Uldaman’s Obsidian Sentinel can drop loot again.
In Blackfathom Deeps the altar resets after three seconds and gives its blessing. The Avatar of Hakkar can spawn again in Sunken Temple.

Riverglades is designed for about levels 38–44. Players advise arriving around 40. This contradicts dungeons:KB-01:13: The item gives 38–44 rather than 35–45.

Pix Xizzix's level-60 weekly quest rotates between dungeons. One week needed Drakkisath and Wyrmthalak (Blackrock Spire) plus Emperor Thaurissan (BRD) instead of Dire Maul. This contradicts dungeons:KB-01:9: The weekly is not always the three Dire Maul items; it rotates.

Forever penalises kill XP more harshly when a much higher-level player is in the group, so boosting by a level 60 is ineffective. Group with players in your level range. This contradicts dungeons:KB-00:4: The guide says Forever added harsher high-level-member penalties, while the beta note says party XP reverted to Classic behaviour.
In Shaper's Terrace the Green Archival Panel summons Vitrix. This contradicts dungeons:KB-18:4: The guide now states the Green panel summons Vitrix, which the known statement left unconfirmed.

Warcraft Tavern's guide gives Alcaz Island Prison a level range of 48–55, wider than the official 48–53. This contradicts dungeons:KB-16:1: The known statement gives 48–53; this guide extends the top of the range to 55.

open_questions.text: **XP per run.** No source gives XP per run for any dungeon on Forever, nor the kill XP of a full clear. Kill XP as a share of Classic Era has no official number.

**"Trivial" and gray levels.** The 13 Nov hotfix never defined "trivial" (now superseded). It is not confirmed whether Forever uses the Classic gray-level formula, or whether the 12-level rule also applies outside instances.
Does Forever also limit entries across different dungeons or over a full day? The November 20 hotfix specifies only the hourly limit for each dungeon.

**Datamined level fields.** Group Finder minimum and maximum levels from the client tables (LFGDungeons, Map, JournalInstance) could not be read, because wago.tools returned 403. The wago.tools branch name for Forever and the live build number are also unknown. foreverdb reports build 1.60.1.70959.

**Classic-dungeon ranges.** Blizzard has published no ranges for the original Classic dungeons in Forever. Maraudon has no per-wing ranges, and it is unclear whether the Group Finder splits the wings.
**Quest rewards.** The "updated rewards" for original dungeon quests are not listed anywhere. The item quality (green or blue) of new drops in the original dungeons is unknown.
**City of Dalaran key.** It is unclear whether Alliance players need the Dalaran Sewer Key, and whether "Mana Wraith" is a real encounter.
**Group sizes.** Group size is unconfirmed for Upper Blackrock Spire, Lower Blackrock Spire and Sunken Temple. One source claims "up to 10 players" in most dungeons.
**Rend's location.** Blizzard's text places Rend in Lower Blackrock Spire.
**Molten Core.** It is unclear whether Molten Core or Blackwing Lair exist at all in Forever, and whether Attunement to the Core is disabled.
**Legacy tiers.** The exact list of dungeons in each Spelunker tier is unpublished. So is whether progress is account-wide.
**Run lengths.** Run lengths are unsourced for Ruins of Lordaeron, Ragefire Chasm, every Scarlet Monastery wing, and every dungeon from Razorfen Downs up, except Krol'dok Stronghold.
**Shaper's Terrace.** Are the crystals used up on every run? Which boss does the green console summon? What is behind the closed raid gate?
**Blackmaw Hold.** Do you have to clear it to reach the Barrow Deeps? What are its boss order and final-boss level? What are its real quest XP totals?
**Boats.** Neither the extra boat routes (Stormwind ↔ Auberdine, Southshore) nor the Skyborne Stormwind → Dalaran portal is officially confirmed.
**Loot details.** Is the Manual Crowd Pummeler still in Gnomeregan? What is Ravager's exact Forever tooltip? What is Deathcharger's Reins' drop rate?

**Classic loop strategies.** Do Scarlet Monastery cleave runs, Zul'Farrak graveyard runs and Maraudon farming still pay off in XP or gold at Forever's kill-XP rates and under the 12-level rule? There is no Forever data.
**Dire Maul tribute.** Do the tribute buffs stack in Forever, and is tribute-chest farming viable for gold?
